kyoto_sonoba.gf_detail: Ask. The soba is juwari, 100% buckwheat milled in-house (Michelin Guide; July 2026 review), but the dipping sauce and broths are soy-based and the menu has sushi and dashimaki. No gluten information.
kyoto_sonoba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soba served in dashi broths and dipping sauce (July 2026), with herring, duck, hamo and fish sushi on the menu (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sonoba.hours_raw: 11:30–15:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday (Tabelog). The Michelin Guide lists Saturday and Sunday to 17:00. No reservations (Tabelog); order and pay at the entrance before sitting at two large shared tables (October 2026). Queues are usual: five waiting before opening on a weekday, 30 min to an hour on summer weekends (July 2026), 15–20 min in September 2026. Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 14 seats (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). On Tominokoji north of Rokujo; 407 m from Gojo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 7 July 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sonoba.notes: [Soba · Gojo Tominokoji, juwari soba on the owner’s own pottery] A bright, renovated room where the owner — soba maker and potter — serves 100% buckwheat soba milled in-house on plates from the studio, with a monthly seasonal bowl and sides of bonito or saba sushi. In the Michelin Guide, and reviewers call it a Bib Gourmand. Expect a queue; order and pay at the door. One July 2026 diner found the noodles clumpy and the soba-yu lukewarm. Lunch only; closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), a soba maker who also makes pottery (Michelin Guide)
chef_bio.background: Per the Michelin Guide: the proprietor is a soba craftsman who makes pottery, mills buckwheat in-house for handmade juwari soba, serves it on tableware of the owner’s own making, and designed the industrial-style interior with recycled materials. Reviewers (June–August 2026) call it a Michelin Bib Gourmand, and mention a pottery space where visitors can try making pottery (August 2026). Opened 7 July 2023 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Juwari mori soba; monthly seasonal soba; bonito sushi.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner came for the soba and left raving about the bonito sushi, wanting a whole roll to take home.
A July 2026 diner noticed reggae playing and a staff vibe unlike a usual soba shop.
A July 2026 diner found the soba weak in aroma and clumpy, the wasabi ordinary and the soba-yu lukewarm, though the dipping sauce was well balanced.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: そば、下京区富小路六条上る本塩竈町533-3、五条駅から407m、11:30〜15:00、水木休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、14席、子供可、2023年7月7日オープン。Michelin Guide (英語): 店主は蕎麦職人で陶芸家、自家製粉の手打ち十割蕎麦を自作の器で、もり蕎麦が看板、月替わりの季節の蕎麦、店主が設計した再生素材の内装。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): ビブグルマン、鱧と Manganji の唐辛子の冷たい蕎麦、すだち蕎麦2,100円、鴨のつけ蕎麦、くるみのまぜそば、にしん蕎麦、鰹の寿司、鯖寿司、鯵の棒寿司、だし巻き、入口で注文と会計、大きな相席のテーブル2つ、行列、陶芸体験。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue, then order and pay at the entrance; shared tables. More than half the guests were from overseas (July 2026). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Michelin Guide listing and Tabelog; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_sonoba.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260101/26039638/ (34.994438, 135.764049); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市下京区本塩竈町533番地 (lot) 44m; offset 5 m north of the Tabelog point because kyoto_this_is_ormary_store shares the address and sat 4.9 m away; 2026-11-06

kyoto_dominique_bouchet_restaurant.gf_detail: Ask. Classic French courses with sauces, bread and pastry desserts (2025–26 reviews); the hotel publishes a food-allergy guide on the restaurant page. No gluten information found.
kyoto_dominique_bouchet_restaurant.vegan_detail: Ask. Butter sauces and seafood and meat courses (2025–26 reviews); a vegetable course dish appears ("Vegetable Symphony", February and March 2025), but no vegan information.
kyoto_dominique_bouchet_restaurant.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30, dinner 17:00–22:00 (last entry 20:00); closed Wednesday except holidays (hotel page; Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Lunch from ¥10,000, dinner from ¥20,000, tax and service included (hotel page); service charge 15% (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「15%」). Cards (incl. UnionPay), Suica-type e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 54 seats and private rooms; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). No children below elementary-school age except in private rooms; jackets recommended for men (Tabelog). On the 3rd floor of The Westin Miyako Kyoto, 2 min from Keage Stn; free hotel bus from Kyoto Stn Hachijo exit (Tabelog). Opened 27 November 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_dominique_bouchet_restaurant.notes: [French · Keage, Dominique Bouchet’s dining room in The Westin Miyako] The Westin Miyako’s main French restaurant, supervised by the Paris chef Dominique Bouchet and run by chef 左古 昂: blue lobster jelly with sea urchin and caviar, lobster Parmentier in caviar butter, sauces that are rich but light, a dessert wagon and city views. Lunch from ¥10,000, dinner from ¥20,000 including service. Reviewers find drinks and water pricey. No young children; jacket suggested. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the hotel page: Dominique Bouchet was chef at La Tour d’Argent and Hôtel de Crillon in Paris, opened Restaurant Dominique Bouchet in Paris’s 8th arrondissement in 2004, and besides Kyoto runs Dominique Bouchet Tokyo in Ginza and the bistro Les Copains de Dominique Bouchet. Chef 左古 昂 trained at Dominique Bouchet Tokyo in Ginza before coming to Kyoto, and has led this kitchen since April 2022. An April 2026 reviewer calls the chef Sako. The same hotel houses Dominique Bouchet Kyoto Le Teppanyaki.
chef_bio.philosophy: An "evolved classic": carefully chosen Japanese ingredients with traditional French technique, and sauces that are "deep yet light" (hotel page).
chef_bio.specialty: Blue lobster jelly with sea urchin and caviar; lobster Parmentier.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 diner found the wine fairly priced for a luxury hotel and the 15% service charge stiff, and noted guests in T-shirts admitted despite the jacket advice.
A January 2026 regular felt the signature blue lobster had become smaller than before.
A June 2025 diner on a third visit asked ahead for Beluga caviar and finished with a choice from a wide range of teas.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: ホテルのページ: 東京でミシュラン一つ星のドミニク・ブシェ監修のフレンチ、左古シェフ (左古 昂、2022年4月から、銀座の Dominique Bouchet Tokyo で研修)、"進化形クラシック"、「味わい深いのに軽やか」なソース、約300種のカーヴ、ランチ11:30〜14:30、ディナー17:00〜22:00 (最終入店20:00)、水曜休み (祝日を除く)、ランチ10,000円〜、ディナー20,000円〜 (税・サービス料込み)、平日限定コース「SOLEIL」、食物アレルギー対応のご案内。食べログ: フレンチ、東山区粟田口華頂町1、蹴上駅から徒歩2分、ウェスティン都ホテル京都3階、サービス料15%、54席、個室、未就学児不可 (個室は可)、男性はジャケット推奨、2019年11月27日オープン。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年7月、英語): ブルーオマールのジュレとウニとキャビア、オマールのパルマンティエ、デザートワゴン、飲み物と水が高い。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course; staff explain each dish (January 2025). Jacket suggested for men; no children under elementary age except in private rooms. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Hotel page and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_yuki_gion.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: vegetable tempura, corn kakiage, fried nama-fu (wheat gluten), nanban-zuke (2026 reviews); soy sauce throughout.
kyoto_yuki_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish and sake izakaya — sashimi, hamo, dashimaki, oden in dashi (2026 reviews).
kyoto_yuki_gion.hours_raw: 16:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, and advised at dinner (June 2026); reservations taken until 19:00 (March 2026). Table charge ¥440 per person (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「440円（税込）」; an appetizer, ¥430 in September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay, no e-money (Tabelog). 58 seats at a counter downstairs and tatami upstairs; non-smoking, smoking area outside (Tabelog). Children and strollers welcome, second floor only (Tabelog). 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 16 December 2009 (Tabelog).
kyoto_yuki_gion.notes: [Izakaya · Gion, a sake brewer’s own bar] A busy two-floor izakaya in Gion run by the Shiga brewer Okamura Honke, pouring its 金亀 sake by polishing ratio — taste the 60% against the 70% — alongside hamo, sashimi, dashimaki and fried nama-fu at prices reviewers call fair for Gion. Many overseas guests; book for dinner. ¥440 table charge. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), trained at a well-known Kyoto restaurant (Tabelog, shop text)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): an izakaya run directly by Okamura Honke, the Shiga sake brewery, serving its sake and fresh fish; the owner trained at a famous Kyoto restaurant. The brewery’s site (kin-kame.co.jp) describes 株式会社 岡村本家 of Toyosato, Shiga, founded in 安政元年 and maker of 金亀 and 大星, and lists the restaurants that pour its sake. A June 2026 review calls the shop a former direct operation of the brewery. Opened 16 December 2009 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: The brewery’s sake by polishing ratio; hamo; fresh fish.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 sake novice compared the 60% (dry) and 70% (rich) and could clearly taste the difference.
A regular on a 13th visit in July 2026 ordered flatfish sashimi and was surprised by the generous portion.
An August 2026 diner found the downstairs counter narrow and not very clean, and staff slow to grasp questions, but every dish beat expectations.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮、東山区富永町111-1、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、16:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、火曜休み、予約可、440円（税込）、カード・QR 可、58席 (カウンター、座敷)、禁煙 (外に喫煙所)、子供は2階のみ、2009年12月16日オープン、店の紹介 (英訳): 滋賀の酒蔵 岡村本家の直営、蔵直送の酒と新鮮な魚、京都の名店で修業した店主。岡村本家のサイト: 滋賀県豊郷町、創業安政元年、金亀・大星。口コミ (2026年3月〜11月、英語): 精米歩合20〜90%の飲み比べ、季節の酒660円、鱧の骨せんべい418円、本鮪中トロ1,309円、おでん、バイ貝、鱧の刺身、生麩の揚げ物、だし巻き、鯖寿司、外国人の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter downstairs, tatami upstairs; sake listed by polishing ratio, so check prices (September 2026). Many overseas guests, but one August 2026 diner found staff slow to grasp questions. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_yuki_gion.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26015626/ (35.004489, 135.774337); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市東山区富永町111番地 (lot) 31m; 2026-11-06

kyoto_teramachi_colombo.gf_detail: Not GF: the signature is a wheat spaghetti, served with bread or focaccia (2026 reviews).
kyoto_teramachi_colombo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: tarako (cod roe) spaghetti with butter or cream, chicken curry, Spanish omelette and desserts (2026 reviews).
kyoto_teramachi_colombo.hours_raw: Lunch and café 12:00–16:00 (food last order 15:00); dinner 18:00–21:00 (food last order 20:00); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, but not for café-only visits (Tabelog); lines at opening and full quickly at weekend lunch, so book (June–September 2026). 20 seats: 8 at the counter and 12 at tables; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). Children welcome, with a kids menu, kids chairs and picture books (Tabelog; August 2026). Cards and transit IC/iD/QUICPay; no QR (Tabelog). Teramachi Nijo; 6 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; September 2026). Opened 25 September 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_teramachi_colombo.notes: [Café-trattoria · Teramachi Nijo, tarako spaghetti] A bright, family-friendly café-trattoria on Teramachi known for its tarako spaghetti set: creamy cod roe pasta under green and red shiso, with salad, soup, Spanish omelette and focaccia, ¥1,600. The owner pours out the stories of a November 2025 visit by the TV show "Sekkaku Gourmet". Desserts and takeaway sweets by day, a short Italian à la carte by night. Book for weekend lunch. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who also handles the dinner service alone on some nights (July 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 25 September 2019, offering set meals full of vegetables and à la carte; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers in 2026 say the restaurant was featured in Banana Man's "Sekkaku Gourmet" (broadcast 9 November 2025), where Himura of Banana Man ate the tarako spaghetti set; a signed photo hangs inside (July–September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Tarako spaghetti.

anecdotes.text: Himura of the comedy duo Banana Man ate the tarako spaghetti set on "Sekkaku Gourmet" (aired 9 November 2025); a July 2026 fan who came for the same set was offered a photo with Himura's signed picture by the owner.
A July 2026 dinner guest noted that the dishes came at a good pace "even with just one person handling it".
A November 2026 regular, hooked since a first visit a year before after seeing the show, was tempted by the daily special but chose the tarako spaghetti again.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ・イタリアン・パスタ、中京区要法寺前町709-2、京都市役所前駅から徒歩6分、12:00〜16:00 (ランチ・カフェ、料理L.O.15:00)、18:00〜21:00 (ディナー、料理L.O.20:00)、水曜定休、予約可 (カフェのみの予約は不可)、20席 (カウンター8、テーブル12)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、車椅子可、子ども連れ歓迎 (キッズメニュー)、カード・交通系IC・iD・QUICPay 可、QR 不可、2019年9月25日オープン、野菜たっぷりの定食とアラカルト。口コミ (2026年6月〜11月、英語): 寺町二条、たらこスパゲティ定食1,600円 (大葉と赤じそ、レモン、サラダ、スープ、スパニッシュオムレツ、フォカッチャ)、大盛り+300円、スパイスチキンカレー、ディナーのアラカルト (カプレーゼ、生ハムと桃、ホタテのジェノベーゼ、アクアパッツァ、タリアータ)、ティラミス、ソフトクリーム、焼き菓子、たらこソースの販売、絵本、週末は予約がおすすめ、「Sekkaku Gourmet」(2025年11月9日放送) で Banana Man の Himura が食べた、サイン入りの写真。

cultural_comfort.note: Book on Tabelog for weekend lunch; set meals on a tray; kids welcome; cards and IC.

existence.note: Official Tabelog listing; reviews through November 2026.

kyoto_node_hotel_restaurant.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog notes allergy information is available; the menu has pasta, bread and cakes alongside carpaccio, roast beef and steak (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_node_hotel_restaurant.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and a focus on vegetables, but the dishes reviewers name use Omi beef, fish, anchovy or dairy (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_node_hotel_restaurant.hours_raw: Daily 7:30–23:00 (food last order 22:00); breakfast 7:30–10:00 by reservation, lunch 11:30–15:00, café 15:00–17:00, dinner and bar 17:00–23:00; closed on irregular days (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog original チャージ料なし). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). 37 seats with counter and sofas; non-smoking, with a smoking room; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi; private hire for over 50 (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). On the ground floor of the node hotel, entered past the lobby; Nishinotoin north of Shijo; 6 min walk from Karasuma or Shijo stations (Tabelog; March and July 2026).
kyoto_node_hotel_restaurant.notes: [Hotel café-bar · Nishinotoin Shijo, art all around] The all-day lounge of the node hotel, hung with large modern paintings and set to jazz: weekday-friendly lunches from ¥2,000 (hamburg steak, pasta, fish of the day, roast-beef bowl, with salad and soup), cakes in the afternoon, and Omi beef, carpaccio and cocktails at night. Most praise the food; one June 2026 guest found the fish tired, and one regular finds the staff a little cool. Open daily to 23:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the café, bar and Italian dining of the node hotel, offering art and food in an extraordinary space, with breakfast, lunch, café and dinner; registered as an official listing by the operator. A January 2026 reviewer describes the hotel concept "Art Close to You" and a farm-to-table menu of seasonal Kyoto ingredients, with fish chosen daily by the chef.
chef_bio.philosophy: Farm to table with seasonal Kyoto ingredients (January 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Omi beef dishes; pasta lunch.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular was unsure at first because the hotel lobby is right at the entrance, but went in on the strength of the sign outside and has been coming back often since.
An October 2026 couple, chatting under the art over hamburg steak and pasta, found the chef and staff so friendly that the visit ran longer than planned.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ・バー・イタリアン、中京区西洞院四条上ル蟷螂山町461、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩6分、毎日 7:30〜23:00 (料理L.O.22:00)、朝食7:30〜10:00 (要予約)、ランチ11:30〜15:00、カフェ15:00〜17:00、ディナー&バー17:00〜23:00、不定休、チャージ料なし、予約可、37席、禁煙 (喫煙室あり)、車椅子可、Wi-Fi、カード・PayPay 可、ホテルのレストラン、野菜にこだわる、アレルギー表示あり、ベジタリアン対応のメニューあり、アートと料理の非日常の空間。口コミ (2026年1月〜10月、英語): ホテルの1階、「Art Close to You」のコンセプト、京都の旬の食材のファーム・トゥ・テーブル、鮮魚のカルパッチョ1,960円、近江牛のローストビーフサラダ2,200円、近江牛のボロネーゼ2,200円、近江牛のステーキ4,180円、ランチ2,000円から (ローストビーフ丼、季節のパスタ、魚料理、ハンバーグ)、ドリンク+300円、ケーキ、タルト、フォンダンショコラ、ジャズ、大きな現代アート、魚がいまひとつとの声 (2026年6月)、スタッフはややクール。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel lounge; walk in past the lobby; book breakfast; cards and PayPay.

positives: Tabelog lists allergy information available and vegetarian options (Tabelog).

existence.note: Official Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_etto_italian.gf_detail: Not GF: the restaurant states it offers no gluten-free menu (Tabelog); the course includes two pastas, bread and grissini (2026 reviews).
kyoto_etto_italian.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the restaurant states it offers no vegan or vegetarian menu (Tabelog); a set course of fish, foie gras and wagyu (2026 reviews).
kyoto_etto_italian.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday–Saturday and holidays 18:00–22:30 (one 18:00 or 18:30 simultaneous start); Sunday lunch 11:30–14:30 and dinner from 18:30; closed Wednesday and twice a month on irregular days (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Reservation only; no vegan, vegetarian or gluten-free menus (Tabelog). A 10% service charge (Tabelog original サービス料10％), on top of the ¥13,200 omakase course, tax included (October 2026). 8 counter seats with an open kitchen; private use possible; non-smoking; bicycle parking on request (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Down a long stone path in a quiet residential lane west of the Kyoto Prefectural Office; 10–15 min walk from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 22 August 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_etto_italian.notes: [Italian omakase · west of the Prefectural Office, hidden townhouse counter] Down a long stone path to a renovated townhouse with a small garden: eight seats at a flat counter where two cooks handle all the cooking and service for one Italian omakase of Kyoto and Japanese produce — ginkgo gnocchi with karasumi, bagna cauda poured as soup, two pastas, charcoal-grilled fish and wagyu — for ¥13,200 plus 10% service. Reviewers in 2026 say it is listed in the Michelin Guide. No vegan, vegetarian or gluten-free menus. Reservation only; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 22 August 2024, a reservation-only eight-seat counter. A September 2026 reviewer names the chef as Seiya Tatsumi, who trained for many years at the Italian restaurant RADICE; reviewers in 2026 say the restaurant is listed in the Michelin Guide Kyoto-Osaka for a second year, and that the name means "small" in Italian (October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Japanese ingredients transformed with Italian technique (August 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase with two pastas; bagna cauda soup.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 guest wrote that two good-looking men handle all the cooking and service, and that the pairing of a Shiraz appassimento with the smoked sirloin cap was the high point.
A September 2026 diner was shown the bread both before and after baking, then served it fresh from the oven mid-course.
Toward the end of the course the staff checked how full each guest was so portions could be adjusted, and tea sweets could be taken home — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・イノベーティブ、上京区大黒屋町47、地下鉄丸太町駅から徒歩10分、月・火・木〜土・祝 18:00〜22:30、日 11:30〜14:30・18:30〜21:30、水曜と月2回の不定休、完全予約制、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン・グルテンフリーのメニューはない、サービス料10%、8席、個室あり、貸切可、禁煙、自転車置き場、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、2024年8月22日オープン。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): 京都府庁の西の住宅街、長い石畳の先の町家、庭、8席のカウンター、おまかせのコース13,200円 (昼も夜も)、2か月ごとに替わる、ワインペアリング込み24,800円、銀杏とピスタチオのニョッキに自家製のからすみ、甘海老、ほおずきとフォアグラのアイス、穴子と落花生のスフォルマート、トリュフ、バーニャカウダのスープ、2種のパスタ (利尻の雲丹と泉州の茄子の冷製、栗のタリアテッレ)、あこうの炭火焼き、長野の牛、ワイン約350本、シェフは Seiya Tatsumi (RADICE で長く修業)、ミシュランガイドに掲載との声。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; one simultaneous-start course; dishes explained; 10% service; cards.

existence.note: Official Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_lannion_marutamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Courses of terrine, soup, fish and meat with homemade bread, choux and pastry desserts; no gluten information (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_lannion_marutamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: French courses of fish, pork, beef and chicken with butter and cream desserts (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_lannion_marutamachi.hours_raw: Tuesday, Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday: lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 13:30), dinner 18:00–21:30 (last order 19:30); closed Monday, Thursday and Friday; hours may change (Tabelog). Dinner by reservation; no children below elementary school age (Tabelog remarks). 20 seats; private hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards: AMEX listed; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 1F of Capital Villa Marutamachi, east of Kawabata Marutamachi on the south side; 2 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; March 2025). Opened 4 November 2005 (Tabelog).
kyoto_lannion_marutamachi.notes: [French · Kawabata Marutamachi, couple-run since 2005] A cosy French restaurant near the Kamo River, run by a warm owner couple since 2005: white tablecloths, paintings, and generous, light classic courses — a Gruyère choux to start, terrine, vegetable soup, fish from Awaji or Aomori, Aichi pork two ways, crème caramel — with homemade bread and fairly priced wine. Lunch is the bargain and fills with regulars. Dinner by reservation; no young children. Open Tuesday, Wednesday and weekends.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 4 November 2005; dinner by reservation, no children below elementary age. Reviewers say the name comes from a town in Brittany (June 2023), that the owner couple greet guests warmly (July 2026), and that the restaurant is often visited by Kyoto University professors, including Nobel laureates (June 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch course; Aichi pork two ways.

anecdotes.text: Asked in June 2023 about speaking fluent French, the owner laughed and said no.
A June 2026 reviewer calls it a place often visited by Kyoto University professors, including Nobel Prize winners.
A March 2026 party of four had the dishes chosen in advance by a guest who once worked with the owner's wife.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フレンチ、左京区川端丸太町東入 キャピタルヴィラ丸太町 1F、京阪神宮丸太町駅から徒歩2分、火・水・土・日 11:30〜15:00 (L.O.13:30)・18:00〜21:30 (L.O.19:30)、月・木・金定休、予約可 (ディナーは要予約)、未就学児不可、20席、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード可 (AMEX)、電子マネー・QR 不可、2005年11月4日オープン。口コミ (2023年6月〜2026年10月、英語): 店名はブルターニュの町の名、白いクロス、絵の飾られた温かい店内、ランチのコース (Déjeuner B 4,500円)、グリュイエールのシュー、京都の若鶏のテリーヌ、鹿児島の Yokowa のミキュイ、野菜のスープ、淡路や青森の魚のポワレ、愛知の豚のロースと頬肉、ステーキ、りんごのミルフィーユ、クレームキャラメルとキャラメルのアイス、メレンゲ、自家製パン、手頃なワイン、オーナー夫妻の温かい迎え、京大の教授やノーベル賞受賞者も訪れるとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book dinner ahead; no young children; set courses; AMEX listed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_ichimaru5_gojozaka.gf_detail: Ask. Rice-flour dango, but the mitarashi glaze and the soy-sauce dango use soy sauce, and the dorayaki is a wheat pancake; no ingredient list published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ichimaru5_gojozaka.vegan_detail: Ask. Dango with mitarashi glaze or bean paste may be plant-based, but no ingredient list is published; the dorayaki has matcha butter cream (March 2026).
kyoto_ichimaru5_gojozaka.hours_raw: 10:00–17:00 daily (Tabelog; hours may change); a March 2026 reviewer visited in the evening on the way to a night opening of Kiyomizu-dera. No reservations (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog; June 2026). 10 seats: 6 at the counter, 4 at a table; an eat-in space and a photo spot (Tabelog; June 2026). Mostly eaten walking — dango served in cups (April 2026). On Gojozaka, the slope up to Kiyomizu-dera, about 1 km from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_ichimaru5_gojozaka.notes: [Dango · Gojozaka, on the way to Kiyomizu-dera] A small, photogenic dango stand on the slope to Kiyomizu-dera: an oversized mitarashi dango (¥330, warm or chilled), soy-sauce and bean-paste dango in takeaway cups, matcha dorayaki and Uji matcha, with a few seats inside. Busy with school trips and tourists. PayPay or cash.

roles: Operated by OKAMOTO Co., Ltd. (per an April 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: An April 2026 reviewer writes that the business began in 1831 as an Okamoto textile shop and has run the kimono rental “Rental Kimono Okamoto” since 2004 under OKAMOTO Co., Ltd., and that ICHiMARU5 is its homemade-dango shop; another April 2026 reviewer says there is a main shop and a Kiyomizu-zaka branch. A March 2026 visitor found the room not very clean and wondered whether it was aimed at overseas guests.
chef_bio.specialty: Large mitarashi dango.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 couple chose the large mitarashi dango chilled on a hot day and shared it.
A May 2026 visitor with a sensitive tongue ate the piping-hot dango inside rather than on the street.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ICHiMARU5、和菓子、東山区五条橋東6-540-6、清水五条駅から966m、毎日10:00〜17:00、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay可、10席 (カウンター6、テーブル4)。口コミ (2026年): 清水寺への坂の手作り団子、大きなみたらし団子330円 (温かいか冷たいか選べる)、醤油団子、あんの団子約300円、抹茶バタークリームのどら焼き360円、宇治抹茶、カップ入りで食べ歩きしやすい、本店と Kiyomizu-zaka の店があるとの声、1831年に Okamoto Textile Shop として始まり、2004年から Rental Kimono Okamoto を営む株式会社OKAMOTO の店とのこと、夜は店内の清潔感がいまひとつとの声 (日本語の口コミ、2026年3月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Point-and-pay dango stand; eat-in seats; PayPay or cash. Popular with overseas visitors.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_ichimaru5_gojozaka.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26038748/ (34.995161, 135.779171); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市東山区五条橋東六丁目540番地 (lot) 18m; 2026-11-06

kyoto_mikuri_kuwa.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a fried-food kappo — panko-fried fish, menchi katsu, tonkatsu, Wagyu cutlet, crab-cream croquettes, fried bread with shrimp paste; homemade Worcester-style sauce (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_mikuri_kuwa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, crab, pork and beef courses with dashi soups (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_mikuri_kuwa.hours_raw: Tuesday dinner only 18:00–22:00 (food L.O. 20:30); Wednesday–Saturday lunch 11:30–14:00 (food L.O. 12:30) and dinner 18:00–22:00 (food L.O. 21:00, Saturday 20:30); Sunday and holidays lunch only; closed Monday, Sunday dinner and the third Sunday (Tabelog). Lunch by reservation only, courses only for seat bookings (official site; Tabelog). “Ryokan-style” breakfast mini-course Saturdays and Sundays in two sittings (8:30 and 10:00), by reservation, ¥3,980; a hotel-stay plan with Agora Hotel (official site). Cards, Rakuten Pay (Tabelog), but set lunches are cash only (July and September 2026). 16 seats: 8 at the ground-floor counter, 8 at tables upstairs, which also serve as a private room for 4–8 (Tabelog). Heated-tobacco area on the ground floor; upstairs non-smoking (Tabelog). Shoes off at the entrance (Tabelog). Children welcome, small children upstairs (Tabelog). Take-away: seko crab, saba sushi, gyu-katsu and tonkatsu sandwiches at New Year (official site). Down an alley off Nishinotoin south of Rokkaku, 9–11 min from Shijo / Karasuma Oike Stns (Tabelog; July 2026). Opened 11 July 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_mikuri_kuwa.notes: [Fried-food kappo · Nishinotoin-Rokkaku, alley counter] A small alley house — shoes off — where fried food becomes kappo: rare-fried horse mackerel, fillet katsu, crab-cream croquettes and menchi katsu from Kinki pork, fried slowly to order, alongside sashimi and seasonal dishes. Lunch sets from ¥1,650 (cash only), dinner courses up to ¥22,000 with natural wine and rare sake, and a ryokan-style breakfast on weekends. Book ahead. Sister of ワインと和食 みくり.

chef_bio.background: The official site describes a chef who has built experience not only in Japanese cooking but also in French cuisine and at a crab ryokan; a June 2026 reviewer calls it “run by a chef with experience in French and Japanese cooking”. A September 2026 diner mentions both “the head chef and the owner” recommending drinks. The invoice number here, T9130001059304, is registered to 株式会社Ｇｒｅｅｎ Ｓｍｉｌｅ (NTA register). The site also advertises a monthly cooking event, “みくり 桑 お料理会”.
chef_bio.philosophy: Local produce for local tables (地産地消), mainly Kinki ingredients; attention to oil and breadcrumbs (official site; July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Rare-fried horse mackerel; crab-cream croquette; menchi katsu.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 lunch guest noted that the fries are cooked slowly at low temperature after ordering, so each takes about 15 minutes.
A July 2026 breakfast guest was shown the clay-pot rice before it steamed, then had a run of dishes during the 10-minute wait.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都フライ割烹 みくり 桑 (みくり くわ)、四条烏丸の路地奥、和食だけでなくフレンチやカニ旅館など様々な経験を積んだシェフ、旬の料理と名物フライをコースで、地産地消、京丹波高原豚、八鹿豚、舞鶴漁港の鮮魚、白中心のナチュールワイン、新政や王祿などの日本酒、2階に個室、朝ごはんは土日のみ2部制 (8時30分〜、10時〜)、要予約3,980円、アゴーラホテルと提携、ランチは事前予約のみ、名物のレアアジフライやヘレカツ、松葉ガニのコース、毎月の「みくり 桑 お料理会」、年末年始のテイクアウト (せこ蟹3,300円、鯖寿司3,800円など)。食べログ: 揚げ物・とんかつ・かに、中京区西洞院通り六角下がる池須町419-6、火は夜のみ、水〜土は昼夜、日・祝は昼のみ、月曜・日曜夜・第3日曜休み、カード・楽天ペイ可、16席 (1階カウンター8、2階テーブル8)、1階は加熱式たばこのみ可、靴を脱いで上がる、子ども可、2024年7月11日オープン、適格請求書 T9130001059304 (株式会社Ｇｒｅｅｎ Ｓｍｉｌｅ)。口コミ (2026年、英語): フライ割烹、八鹿豚のメンチカツ定食1,650円、レアアジフライ、カニクリームコロッケ、22,000円のコース、昼の定食は現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off; lunch by reservation and set lunches cash only. Families welcome upstairs; walk-in foreign families have been seated upstairs (July 2026).

existence.note: Official site with New Year notices; Tabelog reviews through September 2026.

kyoto_kokekokko_isetan.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal yakitori with salt or tare, chicken rice bowls, tororo rice, yuba with sweet soy sauce; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kokekokko_isetan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakitori restaurant; lunch sets with chicken and egg (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kokekokko_isetan.hours_raw: 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00), lunch to 16:00; irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; advised at lunch (October 2026). Dinner table charge ¥330, free for children up to 6 and not added to free-drink courses (Tabelog, original ディナーのみテーブルチャージ料として330円(税込)頂戴いたします。(6歳まで無料/飲み放題付きコースは除く)). Cards and many QR codes; no e-money (Tabelog). 70 seats at tables and a counter (Tabelog). Non-smoking; sommelier; children welcome (Tabelog). Views of Kyoto Tower and the city at night (October 2026). JR Kyoto Isetan 10F, directly connected to Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
kyoto_kokekokko_isetan.notes: [Yakitori · Kyoto Station, Isetan 10F with a tower view] A 70-seat charcoal yakitori room on the restaurant floor of JR Kyoto Isetan, with windows on Kyoto Tower and the night city — handy before a Shinkansen. Lunch sets of charcoal chicken with tororo or an oyakodon-style bowl; at night skewers at about ¥400–450 each or the Oyadori course. ¥330 table charge at dinner. Prices run a little high; busy with tourists.

chef_bio.background: No operator or chef is named in the sources opened. Reviewers praise attentive staff (September 2026). An October 2026 diner on a business trip found service slow, the course skewers brought two at a time, and the neighbouring tourist group loud.
chef_bio.specialty: Binchotan yakitori; charcoal chicken lunch sets.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner waited 20 minutes over edamame before the eight Oyadori skewers arrived, anxious about the Shinkansen.
An October 2026 lunch guest mistook the white dessert for tofu with yuzu before finding it was a milk pudding.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: こけこっこ、居酒屋・ステーキ・焼き鳥、下京区烏丸通塩小路下ル東塩小路町901 ジェイアール京都伊勢丹10F、京都駅直結、11:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、不定休、予約可、ディナーのみテーブルチャージ330円 (6歳まで無料、飲み放題付きコースは除く)、カード・QR決済可、70席、禁煙、ソムリエ、子ども可。口コミ (2026年、英語): 備長炭の焼き鳥、炭火焼き鶏ととろろの御膳、親子丼風の丼、昼のコース3,700円、Oyadori コース、串1本400〜450円、湯葉800円、京都タワーと夜景、やや高め、海外の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Department-store restaurant by the station; many foreign visitors (October 2026). ¥330 table charge at dinner.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_roji_oku_shijo.gf_detail: Ask. Roast beef with red-wine or garlic-soy sauce, hamburg steak with demi-glace, beef cutlet, shrimp tempura, curry, pasta; bread with lunch; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_roji_oku_shijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a roast-beef bistro; consommé soup with the set lunches (2026 reviews).
kyoto_roji_oku_shijo.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30), dinner 17:30–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); closed Wednesday, with Wednesday banquets for about 20 or more on request (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; dinner often fully booked (October 2026). Corkage for brought-in cakes and drinks (Tabelog). Cards, IC, iD, QUICPay and QR codes (Tabelog). 50 seats; private rooms from 4 to over 30 (up to 64 seated), secured for 16 or more at ¥7,000 a head; projector; wheelchair accessible; non-smoking with a smoking spot outside (Tabelog). Children welcome, kids’ menu (Tabelog). Down an alley behind an apartment building on Bukkoji, 5 min from Shijo / Karasuma Stns exit 26 (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 10 August 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_roji_oku_shijo.notes: [Roast beef bistro · down an alley near Shijo Karasuma] True to its name (“the back of the alley”), a stylish bistro bar hidden behind an apartment block on Bukkoji, built around thick-cut roast beef with red-wine or garlic-soy sauce. Lunch sets around ¥2,000–2,700 (roast beef, hamburg, beef cutlet); evenings run to midnight with courses and big private rooms for parties. Dinner books out. Closed Wednesdays.

roles: Representative of 合同会社Rミート, the operating company
chef_bio.background: The company site of 合同会社Rミート (Rmeet) names 井上 剛 as representative and calls Roji-oku the company’s founding shop, opened during the pandemic, with roast beef as its main dish; the “R” stands for Roji-oku, roast beef and royal. Tabelog gives an Inoue mobile number for Wednesday banquet enquiries. Whether the representative cooks is not stated.
chef_bio.philosophy: “Keep doing the obvious things properly”; creating new menus throughout the pandemic (company site).
chef_bio.specialty: Roast beef.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner came back within the month with the diner’s wife, this time for the beef cutlet.
A 21-person workplace alumni party booked a semi-private room for the ¥6,000 free-drink course (October 2026).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 合同会社Rミートのサイト: 代表 井上 剛、創業の地ロジオク、メインディッシュのローストビーフ、R はロジオク、ローストビーフ、ロイヤルの頭文字、コロナ禍に誕生、「気軽に愉しめるカジュアル創作洋食」。食べログ: Roji-oku、ビストロ・バル・洋食、下京区糸屋町215-1 ブローディア仏光寺1F、四条駅・烏丸駅26番出口から徒歩5分、昼11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)、夜17:30〜24:00 (L.O.23:00)、水曜定休 (20名ほどからの宴会は相談可)、ケーキや飲み物の持ち込みは持ち込み料、カード・電子マネー・QR可、50席、個室あり (最大64名)、車椅子可、子ども可、2020年8月10日オープン、適格請求書 T2130003007903。口コミ (2026年、英語): 厚切りのローストビーフ、ハンバーグとのセット2,700円、牛カツ、海老天、6,000円の飲み放題コース、夜は満席が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Casual bistro; set lunches; large private rooms for groups.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_teppan_okonomiyaki_jin.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat-batter okonomiyaki, negiyaki and chijimi, and yakisoba in a house sauce (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_teppan_okonomiyaki_jin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: teppan dishes of pork, beef, squid and egg, with bonito flakes on top (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_teppan_okonomiyaki_jin.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–16:30 (last order 16:00) and 18:00–2:00 (food last order 1:00, drinks 1:30); the 2nd and 4th Wednesday closed in the evening, lunch still served (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised — full soon after opening (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). No service charge (Tabelog original 無し). Cash only (Tabelog; October 2026). 14 seats at tables with teppan griddles, plus a raised tatami area; non-smoking; children welcome, no strollers inside (Tabelog). Menu on the wall (February and October 2026). Nijo-dori west of Takakura; 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog). Opened 1 May 2008 (Tabelog).
kyoto_teppan_okonomiyaki_jin.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Nijo Takakura, open till 2 a.m.] A Showa-feeling okonomiyaki and teppan bar where each dish is finished on the griddle at your table: Kyoto-style beta-yaki and negiyaki, very thin-noodle yakisoba many call the best in town, tonpei-yaki, cheese omelette and cold tofu under spicy chives, with an after-work set of two drinks and two snacks. Run by the chef and a second cook; busy and cramped, so book. Cash only. Lunch and late dinner daily.

roles: Head chef and a second cook (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 1 May 2008, okonomiyaki and beta-yaki in an old-fashioned room; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe two men running the shop, the head chef and what seemed an apprentice (February and August 2026), strong drinks (June 2025) and Kyoto-style yakisoba with very thin noodles (January 2025–October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Thin-noodle yakisoba; negiyaki.

anecdotes.text: A January 2025 regular comes here after almost every after-party in Kyoto and calls the thin-noodle yakisoba the best of the Kyoto yakisoba tried.
A March 2025 traveller liked the yakisoba so much that a second plate followed.
A February 2026 diner with presbyopia struggled to read the menu on the wall, and noted the house custom of ordering the quick dishes first.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お好み焼き・鉄板焼き・居酒屋、中京区二条通高倉西入ル松屋町48-1、烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分、毎日 11:30〜16:30 (L.O.16:00)・18:00〜翌2:00 (料理L.O.1:00、ドリンクL.O.1:30)、第2・第4水曜は夜休み (昼は営業)、予約可、サービス料無し、現金のみ、14席、小上がり、禁煙、子ども可 (ベビーカー不可)、2008年5月1日オープン、昔ながらの空間でお好み焼きとべた焼き。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年10月、英語): 店主と若い料理人の男性二人、壁のメニュー、京都のべた焼き、ねぎ焼き950円 (すじ)、じゃがチーズチヂミ、極細麺の焼きそば (すじ、揚げた豚の脂)、とん平焼き、海鮮の「Umihira-yaki」、チーズオムレツ、げそ焼き、ほうれん草とベーコン、和牛のハラミ、砂肝、コーンバター、ニラの冷奴「Jin Yakko」、2ドリンク2品の「Otsukaresama」セット1,650〜1,800円、濃いハイボール、「Aka」、予約がおすすめ。

cultural_comfort.note: Menu on the wall in Japanese; dishes served on your table griddle; book; cash only.

existence.note: Official Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_donabe_saizen_toyoake.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog's feature list ticks gluten-free options, but no detail is given; the course is clay-pot rice, tofu, vegetables and dashimaki in dashi, with soy-based seasonings likely (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_donabe_saizen_toyoake.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog ticks vegan and vegetarian options, but the set course uses dashi throughout, a dashimaki omelette, and fish, crab or beef rice (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_donabe_saizen_toyoake.hours_raw: Daily 7:00–15:00, seatings from 7:00; closing days may vary (Tabelog; October 2026). Reservation only, online via TableCheck or Instagram — there is no phone (Tabelog remarks; September 2026). No cover charge (Tabelog original チャージ料なし). Children only if able to eat the adult menu; no kids menu (Tabelog). 6 counter seats around the kitchen; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 1F of the Daini Kinken building, Shogoin; 1 min from the Shinmanomachi Nijo bus stop, 8–15 min walk from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 1 April 2026 (Tabelog).
kyoto_donabe_saizen_toyoake.notes: [Clay-pot rice breakfast · Shogoin, six seats from 7 a.m.] A tiny new counter where the owner-chef cooks a clay pot of rice to order for each guest — salmon, beef sukiyaki, crab or the season's matsutake or hamo — after a run of small dishes: vegetable soup, Kitayama tofu to eat with salt, simmered eggplant and a strikingly white dashimaki of rice-fed eggs. Finish with dashi chazuke or take rice balls home. Friendly English-speaking host. Book online only (no phone). Daily from 7:00.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), who runs the counter alone
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 1 April 2026, reservation only, with English-speaking staff; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers in 2026 describe a chef who manages everything alone (August and October 2026), explains each ingredient, recommends sharing pots (September 2026) and chats about Kyoto sights and clay pots.
chef_bio.specialty: Clay-pot rice; white dashimaki of rice-fed eggs.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 guest was told the Kitayama tofu has a cheese-like flavour, so salt or wasabi suits it better than soy sauce — and, not usually a wasabi fan, found the pairing a revelation.
Before cooking the dashimaki, the chef shows guests the eggs: from rice-fed hens, with yolks almost white (October 2026).
A September 2026 family shared crab, salmon and hamo pots on the owner's advice and stayed chatting about sights, local food and clay pots.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 釜飯、左京区聖護院蓮華蔵31 第二近建ビル 1F、京阪三条駅から徒歩10分、地下鉄東山駅から徒歩8分、市バスの Shinmanomachi Nijo 停留所から徒歩1分、毎日 7:00〜15:00、休みは変わることがある、完全予約制 (TableCheck か Instagram)、チャージ料なし、6席 (カウンター)、禁煙、Wi-Fi、英語対応、子どもは大人と同じ料理を食べられる場合のみ、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2026年4月1日オープン、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン・グルテンフリー対応の記載。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): 電話はなくネット予約のみ、店主一人で営む、すり流し、野菜、京都の Kitayama の豆腐 (塩かわさびで)、茄子の煮浸し、米で育てた鶏の白い卵のだし巻き、注文後に炊く土鍋ご飯 (鮭、牛すき焼き、蟹、松茸、鱧、穴子、白ご飯)、いくら・明太子・卵・バターのトッピング、だし茶漬け、残りは笹で包んだおにぎりに、デザート、3,000〜5,000円ほど。

cultural_comfort.note: English-speaking host; book online (TableCheck or Instagram), no phone; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Official Tabelog listing; opened 1 April 2026; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_ajisai_notoyo_nishiki.gf_detail: Not GF: eel grilled with a house tare (soy-based), served over rice; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ajisai_notoyo_nishiki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an eel and river-fish restaurant (Tabelog).
kyoto_ajisai_notoyo_nishiki.hours_raw: 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30); closed Wednesday, or the next weekday when Wednesday is a holiday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; a booking is held 30 minutes (Tabelog); fills quickly at lunch, so book (August 2026). 22 seats: tables for up to 4 and a sunken kotatsu area for 8; private hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog). Menus in English, Chinese and Korean with photos; children and babies welcome — strollers left on the 1F (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 2F above the family river-fish shop in Nishiki Market, up the stairs beside it; 7 min walk from Karasuma or Shijo stations (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_ajisai_notoyo_nishiki.notes: [Eel · Nishiki Market, upstairs from the river-fish shop] A quiet townhouse-style room above a river-fish shop in busy Nishiki Market, serving its eel since 1912: Kansai-style, grilled over binchotan until the skin crackles, glazed with a sweetish house tare. Bowls from ¥2,100 by the portion (half, two-thirds, whole), hitsumabushi and gozen sets with eel roll and dessert. The kitchen and floor, grill master included, are all women. English menu. Lunch only; closed Wednesday.

roles: All-female team including the grill master (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: established in 1912 as an eel restaurant run by a river-fish specialist, grilling over binchotan with a house sauce; a cosy townhouse-style space upstairs staffed entirely by women, the grill master included, and welcoming to solo women diners; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe the river-fish shop on the 1F and eel to take away.
chef_bio.philosophy: A welcoming room for locals, families and travellers (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Kansai-style grilled eel.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular came, as every year, for the Day of the Ox and was glad the prices had not changed since the year before.
A September 2026 diner who used to think of Kaneyo for eel in Kyoto now finds the grilling here more meticulous.
Through the window by the entrance, a June 2026 guest climbing the stairs could see the eel being grilled under the noren.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: うなぎ、中京区錦小路通柳馬場東入東魚屋町173 2F、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩約7分、11:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)、水曜定休 (祝日は営業し振替休み)、予約可 (30分を過ぎると取り消しの場合あり)、22席、掘りごたつ、貸切20名まで、禁煙、英語・中国語・韓国語の写真付きメニュー、子ども可 (ベビーカーは1階に)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。店の紹介: 1912年創業、川魚の専門店が営むうなぎ店、自家製のたれと備長炭、外はカリッと中はふんわり、町家風の空間、焼き手を含め女性スタッフのみ、「Ajisai Unagi Gozen」5品 (半身4,500円、3分の2 5,000円、1本6,000円)。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年10月、英語): 1階は川魚の店で持ち帰り、2階が食事処、関西風のカリッとした鰻、甘めのたれ、うな丼2,100円、上うな丼3,700円 (肝吸い付き)、一本の丼4,800円、ひつまぶし、肝焼き700円、薄切りの鯉、土用の丑の日。

cultural_comfort.note: English, Chinese and Korean picture menus; book for lunch; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Official Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_boulangerie_morimori.gf_detail: Not GF: a wheat bakery — baguettes of Hokkaido wheat, croissants, pies and curry bread (2026 reviews).
kyoto_boulangerie_morimori.vegan_detail: Ask. Baguettes and plain loaves may suit, but there is no ingredient information; most items use butter, cream, cheese or beef curry (2026 reviews).
kyoto_boulangerie_morimori.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 7:30–18:00; closed Monday and some irregular days; hours may change (Tabelog). Bread can be reserved from a single item (Tabelog). Cash or PayPay only (Tabelog original 現金、PayPay払いのみ). Self-service, except chilled items; breads come bagged (March and August 2026). Takeaway only; a paid car park next door (Tabelog). Nijo-dori west of Higashinotoin; about 300 m from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 28 May 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_boulangerie_morimori.notes: [Bakery · Nijo Higashinotoin, south of Marutamachi] A small bakery with a big savoury range at everyday prices: its baked beef curry bread, as seen on TV, a chewy high-hydration dough, Hokkaido-wheat baguettes, Gorgonzola and honey, cream cheese and raisin, plus croissants, apple pie and canelés. Bread can be reserved by phone even one piece. Cash or PayPay only. Open from 7:30; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 28 May 2019; reservations taken from one bread. Reviewers in 2026 describe a charming small shop in an area thick with bakeries, a baked curry bread featured on "Matsuko's Unknown World" (May and June 2026), and a soft, chewy high-hydration dough (June 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Baked curry bread.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 bread tourist made this the second stop on a walk from Shio Pan Jiro to Nishiki Market, buying the baked curry bread seen on "Matsuko's Unknown World" and a Hokkaido-wheat baguette.
An August 2026 shopper found the sliced loaf and the round bread, made from the same dough, so different in texture as to seem like two products.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: パン、中京区二条通東洞院西入仁王門町11、丸太町駅から308m、火〜日 7:30〜18:00、月曜定休と不定休、パン1個から予約可、現金と PayPay のみ、禁煙、隣に有料駐車場、2019年5月28日オープン。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): 小さなパン屋、惣菜パンが多い、250〜300円ほど、冷蔵品以外はセルフ、袋入り、テレビ「Matsuko’s Unknown World」で紹介された焼きカレーパン250〜260円、北海道産小麦のバゲット340円、食パンと丸パン、パン・オ・ショコラ280円、三角チョコパイ420円、アップルパイ420円、カヌレ320円、ゴルゴンゾーラとはちみつ230円、クリームチーズとはちみつレーズン、チョコオレンジ、クリームパン、加水の多いもちもちの生地。

cultural_comfort.note: Self-service bagged breads; pay in cash or PayPay; reserve by phone if needed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_boulangerie_morimori.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260202/26032453/ (35.013795, 135.760047); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市中京区仁王門町11番地 (lot) 4 m; nearest Kyoto record 90 m away; 2026-11-06

kyoto_kissa_rokka.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a café menu of toast, sandwiches, quiche, tarts and French toast (June 2026 review).
kyoto_kissa_rokka.vegan_detail: Ask. A daily vegetable-soup lunch is offered, but nothing vegan is marked (June 2026 review).
kyoto_kissa_rokka.hours_raw: 11:00–18:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (official site; Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; June 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 20 seats at tables, with red velvet sofas and chairs and a view of a small garden; non-smoking; quiet, with no background music (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). On a lane behind a white brick wall about 5 min from Higashiyama Stn (262 m), near Higashiyama-Sanjo; moved here from Shirakawa (Tabelog; August 2025).
kyoto_kissa_rokka.notes: [Kissa · Higashiyama-Sanjo, a quiet hand-drip coffee room] A calm, homely kissa behind a white brick wall a few minutes from Higashiyama Station, with red velvet seats, pretty tableware and a little garden. Coffee is hand-dripped cup by cup; lunch runs to quiche, soup or a daily plate (about ¥1,350–1,400), and tea time to fruit tarts, French toast and parfaits. Mostly locals, no music. Cash only. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: coffee hand-dripped carefully one cup at a time; site copyright from 2016. Tabelog notes a move from the Amenity Shirakawa building in Shirakawa to the present address.
chef_bio.specialty: Hand-drip coffee with a fruit tart.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 lunch guest was asked on arrival to confirm having cash, as payment is cash only.
An October 2025 visitor liked the café’s teacups so much that one went home with the visitor.
An April 2025 pair stopped in after cherry-blossom viewing at Maruyama Park for coffee and a kumquat and orange tart.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kissa-rokka.com): 喫茶 六花 (ROKKA)、京都・東山三条、コーヒーは一杯ずつハンドドリップで丁寧に、東山区稲荷町南組577-4、11:00〜18:00、火曜・水曜定休。食べログ: 喫茶店・カフェ、東山駅から262m、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、20席 (4人席1、2人席8)、禁煙、白川のアメニティ白川1階から移転。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 日替わりランチ1,350円、キッシュランチ1,400円、季節の野菜スープランチ1,400円、カレー1,400円、サンドイッチ1,300円〜、バタートースト400円、フレンチトースト950円、ケーキ700円〜 (タルトが中心)、六花パフェ1,200円、ホットコーヒー650円、現金のみ、BGM なし、赤いビロードの椅子、小さな庭。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; a quiet room favoured by locals.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through June 2026.

kyoto_kissa_rokka.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26000343/ (35.007374, 135.77804); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市東山区稲荷町南組577番地 (lot) 18m; 2026-11-06

kyoto_soba_teuchi_takahashi.gf_detail: Ask. The soba is juwari (100% buckwheat), but it comes with dipping sauce, and the sets include tempura and mackerel sushi; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_soba_teuchi_takahashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based dipping sauce, with tempura, chicken and mackerel sushi on the sets (2026 reviews).
kyoto_soba_teuchi_takahashi.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) daily except Wednesday and the 2nd and 4th Tuesday; dinner 18:00–22:00 (last order 20:30) Thursday–Saturday (Tabelog). Bookings via Tabelog; tables are few, so book (March 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 38 seats over two floors of tatami rooms with tables, shoes off; a private room for 11–20 on the 1st floor; steep stairs and high entrance steps — not wheelchair accessible (Tabelog; June 2026). Cards, transit IC and other e-money, and QR including PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). In a renovated Showa-era former teahouse (ochaya) in the old Gojo district by the Takase River, 256 m from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 27 May 2021 (Tabelog).
kyoto_soba_teuchi_takahashi.notes: [Soba · Gojo, juwari soba in an old teahouse] A hand-made soba house in a Showa-era former teahouse by the Takase River, where you take your shoes off and eat in small tatami rooms. Each month brings 100% buckwheat soba from three regions — taste all three side by side for ¥1,500, with salt. Lunch sets add mackerel sushi or soba-gaki; Thursday to Saturday evenings bring soba-mae snacks and soba kaiseki. Service can be slow when busy. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Cooks trained in Gion (Tabelog); not named; the invoice is registered to an individual proprietor
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: authentic hand-made soba and creative Japanese food by cooks trained in Gion, in a historic building at Gojo-Kawaramachi; 100% buckwheat soba; seasonal Kyoto ingredients for the dinner courses. Opened 27 May 2021 (Tabelog); a May 2026 reviewer saw its 5th-anniversary sticker. An October 2026 reviewer says the owner serves slightly smaller soba so guests can also enjoy seasonal dishes.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per an October 2026 review: the owner wants guests to enjoy seasonal dishes as well as soba.
chef_bio.specialty: Three-region juwari zaru soba tasting.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner recommended eating the juwari soba with salt to taste the buckwheat itself.
A June 2026 guest with a cane needed help with the high steps at the entrance and reports the inside is not wheelchair accessible.
A March 2026 diner waited about 30 minutes for food on a busy day.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 蕎麦手打ち たか橋、そば、下京区平居町23、清水五条駅から256m、昼11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30、水曜と第2・4火曜休み)、夜は木〜土18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 20:30)、38席、1階に11〜20名の個室、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2021年5月27日オープン、インボイス登録は個人事業者。公式紹介: 五条河原町の歴史ある建物、祇園で修業した職人の本格手打ちそばと創作和食、十割そば、夜は京都の季節の食材のコース。コース: 秋のそば懐石9品5,000円、90分飲み放題付き7,500円、たか橋の夜定食3,000円 (税込)。口コミ (2026年3〜11月、英語): 元お茶屋の建物、靴を脱いで上がる、Suwa (Nagano)、Higashikagura (Hokkaido)、Yosano (Kyoto) などの十割ざるそば3種の食べ比べ1,500円、鯖寿司、そばがき田楽、そば湯とそば粉のミニドーナツ、車椅子不可。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests; shoes off; steep stairs.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with bookable courses; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_wakamatsuya_sakaten.gf_detail: Ask. Seafood omakase and hot pots (fugu, hamo, sea bream) with ponzu and other seasonings; no gluten information is published (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_wakamatsuya_sakaten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood hot-pot courses (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_wakamatsuya_sakaten.hours_raw: Evenings 18:00–22:00, Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). By day a sake shop; at night a reservation-only seafood hot-pot omakase. Very hard to book: Friday nights about six months out, and the winter fugu season months to over half a year ahead (February and September 2026). Drinks are self-service from the shop’s fridges and shelves at retail prices — tell the owner what you take; totals of about ¥12,000–15,000 a head with drinks are reported (2025–2026 reviews). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 20 seats; private hire possible; smoking allowed per Tabelog. On Shichijo-dori west of Karasuma, 438 m from Kyoto Stn, in a Showa-retro room (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_wakamatsuya_sakaten.notes: [Izakaya · near Kyoto Station, a sake shop's secret hot-pot nights] A neighbourhood sake shop on Shichijo-dori that turns, by reservation only, into a Showa-retro room of seafood feasts: big platters of sashimi and abalone, then the season's hot pot — fugu in winter, sea bream in spring, hamo in summer. Help yourself to sake and beer from the shop fridges at retail prices and tell the owner. About ¥12,000–15,000 all in. Booked months ahead; cash only. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner not named; the shop is run as a sake retailer by day (reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per 2025–2026 reviews: a local sake shop near Kyoto Station that runs reservation-only seafood hot-pot evenings for regulars; drinks are sold at shop prices and taken from the fridges self-service; the course changes with the season’s fish.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal seafood hot pot — fugu, sea bream, hamo.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 regular was messaged the day before to choose between crab and grouper, depending on the catch.
A May 2026 party stood up to photograph each large platter on arrival.
A December 2025 first-timer got in only through a cancellation.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 若松家酒店、居酒屋・鍋、下京区七条通烏丸西入ル西境町166、京都駅から438m、月〜土18:00〜22:00、日祝定休、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、20席、貸切可、喫煙可。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 昼は酒屋、夜は予約制の海鮮の鍋のおまかせ、酒は小売価格で冷蔵庫からセルフ、店主に申告、冬のてっちりなど河豚づくし、春の鯛しゃぶ、夏の鱧鍋、鮎と鴨の鍋、蟹かクエ、金曜は半年待ち、冬は数か月〜半年以上前に予約、飲んで1人12,000〜15,000円ほど、昭和レトロの店内。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation-only and booked months ahead; cash only; self-service drinks.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_sakenonki_bingo.gf_detail: Ask. Simmered niku-dofu, sesame-miso sea bream, croquettes, spring rolls and akashiyaki; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_sakenonki_bingo.vegan_detail: Ask. A meat- and fish-led izakaya menu with a few vegetable dishes such as fried eggplant and myoga; nothing vegan is marked (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sakenonki_bingo.hours_raw: 16:00–23:00 daily (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30) (Tabelog). Reservations essential — walk-ins are often turned away (August–October 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 34 seats including a counter, in a renovated townhouse; non-smoking; cards (including UnionPay), transit IC, iD, QUICPay and QR including PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Off Nishikikoji west of Karasuma, about 10 min from Karasuma or Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 4 September 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sakenonki_bingo.notes: [Izakaya · Nishikikoji, a lively townhouse sakaba] A buzzing, booking-only izakaya in an old townhouse west of Karasuma, with a cheerful crew at the counter. Order the famous niku-dofu (beef tendon and tofu), sesame-miso sea bream and pork belly wrapped in lettuce, then make your own highballs from a bottle at the strength you like. Good-value and strongly seasoned, built for drinking. Open daily from 16:00; book ahead.

roles: Run by 株式会社Atari (operator site); no chef named
chef_bio.background: Per the operator’s site: 株式会社Atari runs four Kyoto sakaba — 酒呑気びんご, the neo-bistro 六角ace, 酒ﾉみつぼし and ageru. — and describes びんご as a Tokyo-style popular sakaba blended with Kyoto warmth. Per Tabelog’s official introduction: a casual pub whose concept is "connecting people". Opened 4 September 2020 (Tabelog); a September 2026 reviewer attended its sixth-anniversary menu.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: "connecting people".
chef_bio.specialty: Niku-dofu; sesame-miso sea bream.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular on a sixth visit ate from a special anniversary menu of maki sushi, crab cream croquettes and pudding.
An August 2026 couple saw walk-ins turned away and advise booking.
A September 2026 guest at a 16:00 holiday slot found a sister shop’s card in the restroom.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 株式会社Atari (kyoto-atari.co): 酒呑気びんご、六角ace、酒ﾉみつぼし、ageru. の4店、びんごは東京仕込みの大衆酒場スタイルと京都らしい温もり、名物の肉豆腐や創作アテ。食べログ: 居酒屋、中京区西錦小路266、烏丸駅・四条駅から徒歩10分、16:00〜23:00 (料理L.O. 22:00、ドリンクL.O. 22:30)、34席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2020年9月4日オープン、公式紹介: 「人と人をつなぐ」、名物の肉豆腐、Tanteki、鯛のごま味噌、好みの濃さで割って飲めるボトル。口コミ (2026年、英語): 京町家を改装、予約必須、豚バラのレタス巻き、牛タン、コンビーフのポテサラ、チョリソーの春巻、明石焼、Unagi Tamago、茄子と茗荷の揚げ浸し、桃のマスカルポーネ、6周年の特別メニュー。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; friendly counter staff.

existence.note: Operator site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_menya_torihisa.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen noodles in shoyu, chicken paitan and abura soba; fried chicken kara-age (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_menya_torihisa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken broths and chicken toppings; the shop is part of a chicken shop (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_menya_torihisa.hours_raw: 11:00–14:00 (L.O. 14:00); closed Thursday (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Pay first, then sit (March 2026). No cards or e-money; PayPay and other QR codes (Tabelog). 8 seats: 4 at the counter and a table for 2 (Tabelog); a counter inside a chicken shop that also sells meat and kara-age bento (2026 reviews). Non-smoking; school-age children welcome (Tabelog). Shogoin, 5 min from the Higashiyama-Nijo / Okazaki-koen bus stop and about 6 min from Miyako Messe (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 10 October 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_menya_torihisa.notes: [Ramen · Shogoin near Okazaki, inside a chicken shop] An eight-seat lunch counter tucked into a chicken shop near Miyako Messe and Heian Shrine, said by a reviewer to belong to the Higashiyama chicken specialist Torihisa: clear or creamy chicken-broth ramen from ¥850 with chicken chashu, abura soba, and the shop’s own kara-age. Pay first; PayPay or cash. Lunch only; closed Thursdays.

roles: Staff (unnamed) of the chicken shop Torihisa
chef_bio.background: An April 2026 reviewer writes that the shop is run by “Torihisa,” a chicken specialty restaurant in Higashiyama; others describe a ramen counter attached to a butcher-style chicken shop that sells meat and kara-age bento, with friendly staff (March and September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken-broth shoyu and chicken paitan ramen; kara-age.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 regular comes every June and August for events nearby and brought a daughter home from Tokyo.
An October 2026 visitor found it by searching for ramen near Miyako Messe during an event.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 麺屋 とりひさ、ラーメン、左京区聖護院蓮華蔵町31 近建第二ビル1F、市バス東山二条・岡崎公園口から徒歩5分、11:00〜14:00、木曜定休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay など QR決済可、8席 (カウンター4、テーブル2)、禁煙、小学生以上の子ども可、2023年10月10日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 東山の鶏の専門店「とりひさ」の店、鶏肉や唐揚げ弁当も売る店内のカウンター、鶏ガラの醤油ラーメン850円、鶏白湯、特製醤油1,290円、夏は冷やし塩、油そば、唐揚げ、鶏丼、先に会計。

cultural_comfort.note: Pay at the counter first; small shop inside a chicken shop. PayPay or cash.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_ninuki_yabushita.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: egg sandwiches on white bread (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ninuki_yabushita.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an egg-sandwich shop — boiled, scrambled and fried eggs with mayonnaise, ham, tuna or mentaiko (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ninuki_yabushita.hours_raw: 9:00–17:00; irregular closures (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards (AMEX), e-money, PayPay and QR (Tabelog; November 2026). 6 seats; take-away too (Tabelog; May 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). A yellow, egg-themed room with an egg song playing and coffee in egg-shaped cups (April and July 2026). On Yabushita-cho in Shimogyo, about 540 m from Gojo Stn; coin parking nearby (Tabelog; 2025 review). Opened 1 September 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_ninuki_yabushita.notes: [Egg sandwiches · Shimogyo, a yellow egg café] A tiny six-seat, all-yellow café — an egg song on the speakers, coffee in egg-shaped cups — making nothing but egg sandwiches: mashed boiled egg, scrambled, fried egg with ham, teriyaki or mentaiko, generously filled, from about ¥450–600. Eat in or take away; open 9:00–17:00. The name is Kyoto dialect for a boiled egg.

chef_bio.background: No owner is named in the sources read. A February 2025 reviewer found the service very pleasant but the bread a little dry; on a later visit (November 2026) the bread was moist. A July 2026 reviewer recalled a grandmother explaining that “ninuki” means the boiled egg served with morning coffee and toast.
chef_bio.specialty: Egg sandwiches.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor could not get the shop’s egg song out of the visitor’s head for the rest of the day.
An April 2026 restaurateur on a camper-van trip to Ise called the soft-boiled egg sandwich the best egg sandwich ever.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: NINUKI、サンドイッチ、下京区藪下町6、五条駅から538m、9:00〜17:00、不定休、予約不可、カード (AMEX)・電子マネー・QR可、6席、禁煙、2022年9月1日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): たまごサンドの専門店、「にぬき」は京都の言葉でゆで卵、ゆで卵をつぶしたものかスクランブルか両方、スクランブル550円、ハムエッグ約600円、照り焼き、明太子、ツナ、目玉焼き、黄色い店内、卵の歌、卵形のカップのコーヒー、持ち帰り可。

cultural_comfort.note: Point-and-order sandwich counter; take-away available.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_nishiki_daiyasu.gf_detail: Ask. Raw oysters are naturally gluten-free, but sauces are not described; fried oysters, tempura and oyster gratin contain wheat (Tabelog shop text; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_nishiki_daiyasu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an oyster and seafood bar (Tabelog shop text; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_nishiki_daiyasu.hours_raw: 11:00–19:00 (L.O. 18:30) daily; hours may vary (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, original なし; the English page’s “a service charge may be added” is a mistranslation). Cards, IC, e-money and QR (Tabelog; PayPay per September 2026). 38 seats: 18 at the counter and two tables inside, plus a back garden with 4 counter seats and two tables (Tabelog). Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). English, Simplified Chinese and Korean menus with photos; digital menu (Tabelog). In Nishiki Market between Takakura and Sakaimachi, about 4 min from Hankyu Karasuma Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_nishiki_daiyasu.notes: [Oysters · Nishiki Market, since 1921] A long counter and a small back garden inside Nishiki Market where a fourth-generation oyster family shucks four kinds of raw oysters from around Japan — about ¥2,750 for an assortment of four — alongside fried and grilled oysters, gratin and sashimi. Multilingual menus; no reservations; quieter in mid-afternoon. No service charge.

roles: Owner (unnamed), fourth generation per the shop text
chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text: founded in 1921, when the current owner’s great-grandfather began selling oysters from a boat at the foot of Shijo Ohashi, later setting up the shop in Nishiki Market. Reviewers praise friendly staff and an enthusiastic young woman calling in customers at the front (October 2026); an August 2026 first-timer found the system unclear until asking.
chef_bio.philosophy: Fresh oysters, rigorously tested for safety (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Raw oysters; oyster gratin.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 couple shared twenty raw oysters and ordered the gratin twice.
An October 2026 regular hopes the shop keeps its style as Nishiki fills with inbound-oriented stalls.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 錦・だいやす、牡蠣・魚介・オイスターバー、中京区錦小路通高倉東入中魚屋町509 京都市錦市場、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩約4分、毎日11:00〜19:00 (L.O.18:30)、予約不可、サービス料なし、カード・電子マネー・QR可、38席 (店内カウンター18・テーブル2、奥の庭にカウンター4・テーブル2)、禁煙、車椅子可、子ども可、英語・簡体字・韓国語メニュー。店の紹介: 1921年創業、現店主の曾祖父が四条大橋のたもとで船から牡蠣を売り、のちに錦市場に店を構えた、検査済みの生牡蠣4種、造り、おばんざい、天ぷら、奥に庭の席。口コミ (2026年、英語): 生牡蠣4種盛り2,750円、Akkeshi の Maruemon、焼き牡蠣、蒸し牡蠣、カキフライ、牡蠣グラタン、昼過ぎは空いている。

cultural_comfort.note: English, Chinese and Korean menus with photos (Tabelog); ask staff about the ordering system.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_restaurant_kikusui_shijo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: bifkatsu, croquettes, beef stew with demi-glace, sandwiches, bread or rice with sets (official site; 2026 reviews). Ask for grilled dishes.
kyoto_restaurant_kikusui_shijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Western-style meat and seafood menu (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_restaurant_kikusui_shijo.hours_raw: Ground floor café-restaurant 10:00–21:30; 2nd-floor French grill 11:00–20:00; rooftop beer garden in summer 16:30–22:00 (food L.O. 21:30; the 2026 season ran 7 May–17 October); open year-round (Tabelog; official site). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). 10% service charge only for reserved use of the 3rd and 4th floors (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 400 seats over several floors; banquet halls on 3F–4F for up to 130; designated smoking area (Tabelog; official site). Children welcome, kids’ menu (Tabelog). Minami-za intermission bento ordered at the restaurant and collected at the theatre (October 2026). 10% off food and drink with the municipal Kamohigashi car park next door (Tabelog). At the east end of Shijo Ohashi, opposite Minami-za, by Gion-Shijo Stn exit 7 (Tabelog).
kyoto_restaurant_kikusui_shijo.notes: [Yoshoku · Shijo Ohashi opposite Minami-za, since 1916] A landmark Western-style restaurant in a registered cultural-property building at the Gion end of Shijo Ohashi: a retro ground-floor parlour for bifkatsu, beef stew and hamburg sets (about ¥2,400–2,700 with soup, dessert and coffee), a French grill upstairs with crêpes Suzette flambéed at the table, banquet halls, and a rooftop beer garden over the Kamo in summer. Handy before or between Kabuki at Minami-za.

chef_bio.background: The official site: founded in 1916 (Taisho 5) at the foot of Shijo Ohashi; the building is a registered tangible cultural property that keeps its original retro atmosphere; the owner, 奥村洋史, chooses the wines as sommelier and holds a Kyoto Prefecture fugu-handling licence. A September 2026 reviewer adds that the site was a rice-cracker shop before Kojiro Okumura turned it into a Western restaurant after a visit to Shanghai. A September 2026 diner on the autumn course found the service “horrendous from start to finish”; others praised quick service between Kabuki performances (October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Bifkatsu; beef stew; crêpes Suzette.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 Kabuki-goer ordered the “Gion” Western bento across from Minami-za and collected it at the theatre entrance in the first interval.
An October 2026 diner between afternoon and evening Kabuki performances had lunch on the table five minutes after ordering.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: レストラン菊水、四条大橋のたもと、大正5年 (1916年) 創業、国登録文化財の建物、1Fはカフェ・喫茶・軽食のレストランパーラー (ビフカツ、ビーフシチューが人気)、2Fは本格フレンチグリル (祇園ディナー、ロブスターの煮込み、ステーキ、目の前でフランベするクレープシュゼット、オーナーソムリエ選びのワイン、冬はとらふぐと牛のコース、オーナー奥村洋史はふぐ処理師免許)、3F・4Fは130名までの宴会場、屋上ビアガーデン (2026年は5月7日〜10月17日)、テイクアウト。食べログ: 洋食・フレンチ・ビアガーデン、東山区四条大橋東詰南座前、1F 10:00〜21:30、2F 11:00〜20:00、年中無休、予約可、3・4F貸切はサービス料10%、カード可、400席、子ども可。口コミ (2026年、英語): ハンバーグ定食2,640円、クリームコロッケ定食2,420円、ビーフシチュー、秋のディナー4,400円、南座の幕間弁当、接客がひどかったとの声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Large, easy-going restaurant by Minami-za; a name list at the door when busy (October 2026).

existence.note: Official site with October 2026 beer-garden notice; Tabelog reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_vance_yogashiten.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a Western-style cake shop — sponge cakes, cream puffs, pound cake, kugelhopf, millefeuille-style tortes (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_vance_yogashiten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream cakes, cheesecakes, custard puffs and pudding (reviews).
kyoto_vance_yogashiten.hours_raw: Tabelog: 10:00–20:00, closed Tuesday; hours may change. 19 seats — 3 at the counter, 16 at tables — for cake and coffee; take-out; birthday cakes to order (April 2026); non-smoking. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). The website Tabelog lists no longer belongs to the shop.
kyoto_vance_yogashiten.notes: [Cake shop & café · by Higashiyama Station, an old-school Western pâtisserie] A retro-lit cake shop with a little café a minute from Higashiyama Station, handy after Eikando or the Kyoto City art museum: Black Forest, Dobos torte, kugelhopf, honey mousse and a shortcake at ¥600. Regulars call the cakes "deliciously ordinary" — reliable rather than flashy. Cash only. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2023–2026 describe a Western-style pastry shop like the ones of their childhood, with a showcase on the left, about four tables, retro lighting, polite staff, a steady flow of customers, and cakes now mostly a little over ¥500 because of rising costs. A Sunday in April 2026 found a mothers’ tea party in the café.
chef_bio.specialty: Black Forest; Dobos torte; kugelhopf.

anecdotes.text: "I can’t help but feel that there are fewer and fewer cake shops like this one that serve 'deliciously ordinary' treats." — September 2023.
A regular comes back for the Black Forest, "which is hard to find at other bakeries" (November 2025).
March 2026: "when a cake costs more than a beef bowl, it better be delicious!" — a ¥600 shortcake.
A September 2025 regular found the kugelhopf’s liqueur "a bit milder than usual… Was it just my imagination?"

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Vance洋菓子店、喫茶店・ケーキ・チョコレート、東山区三条東入ル分木町77、地下鉄東西線東山駅2番出口から徒歩1分、10:00〜20:00、火曜休み、19席 (カウンター3、テーブル16)、テイクアウト、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2023年9月〜2026年7月、英語): 昔ながらの洋菓子店、喫茶スペース、レトロな照明、ドボシュトルテとティラミス各480円、ショートケーキ600円、スフレチーズケーキ450円、コーヒー450円、シュークリーム、パウンドケーキ3種、レアチーズ、カシス、モンブラン、ハニームース、ココナッツケーキ、ホワイトチョコのケーキ、クグロフ、ハードチーズケーキ、プリン、ブラックフォレスト、誕生日ケーキの予約可、値上げで500円を超えるケーキが多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the showcase; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_stand_sakaba_stem.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the signature is a breaded eel cream croquette; spring rolls and curry croquettes too (official site; 2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_stand_sakaba_stem.vegan_detail: Not vegan: small plates of fish, duck, beef and eel; oden in hamo dashi (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_stand_sakaba_stem.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: 18:00–2:00 (last orders food 1:00, drinks 1:30); closed Tuesday. 20 places — counter 4, standing 10, five tables for 2; private hire up to 20; heated-tobacco area, and a smoking area inside for cigarettes (Tabelog). Cards and most e-money and QR (official site). Service charge: none — Tabelog’s Japanese original says 「なし」 (the English auto-translation wrongly says one is added). Second floor, easy to miss (2026 reviews). Opened 6 March 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_stand_sakaba_stem.notes: [Stand bar · Shijo-Karasuma, small plates till 2 am] A second-floor stand-and-sit bar near Shijo-Karasuma open until 2 am: inventive small plates — eel cream croquette, lotus root with mimolette, fig butter — and a rotating sake list. Lively with locals; one diner missed chairs with backs. Smoking area inside. No service charge. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Not named in a source; one of three bars run together with スモーク＆グリル ロータス and 炭火焼×ワイン チャコール (official site)
chef_bio.background: Opened 6 March 2023 (Tabelog). The shared official site presents it as the casual, drop-in sibling of two Italian bars in the Shijo-Karasuma back streets, Smoke & Grill LOTUS and Charcoal, with standing places for one-person drinking, a pre-party or a second or third stop. It joins a yearly Sake Day event with the sake bar 日本酒BAR ○△□ and a curry and craft ginger ale shop (2024–2026 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「気軽に立ち寄れる酒場」 — a bar you can drop into easily.
chef_bio.specialty: Eel cream croquette; seasonal small plates.

anecdotes.text: "I arrived already tipsy and immediately thought, 'I should have come here first!'" — April 2026.
A July 2026 business traveller found it open past 11 pm when everything else was closing — "What I particularly loved was the fig butter."
"I think it would have been even better if the chairs had backrests." — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (lotus0610.com): スモーク＆グリル ロータス、炭火焼×ワイン チャコール、スタンド酒場 ステムの3店、ステムは気軽に立ち寄れる酒場、小皿料理 (ハーフサイズもあり)、名物のウナクリームコロッケやお造り、1人飲み・0次会・2軒目3軒目に、下京区郭巨山町30 ホーリーハウス 2F、四条駅25番出口から徒歩4分、18:00〜2:00 (L.O. 1:00)、火曜休み、カード・電子マネー可。食べログ: 居酒屋・立ち飲み・バル、20席 (カウンター4、立ち10、2人テーブル5)、貸切20名、加熱式たばこ専用の喫煙所と店内の紙たばこの喫煙所、サービス料は原文で「なし」、2023年3月6日オープン、のりポテトサラダ、カウンターのおばんざい。口コミ (2024年10月〜2026年10月、英語): 蓮根のミモレット焼き、牛タンの低温調理とねぎ塩、鴨胸の醤油麹漬け ほうじ茶マスタード、鰹と柿のカルパッチョ、鱧だしのおでん、カレーコロッケ、鮎のコンフィ、無花果バター、燻製ポテトチップス、日本酒 (Jikon、Isojiman、Nabeshima など)、日本酒の日のイベント、飲み放題のコース、2階でわかりにくい、背もたれのない椅子、地元の常連でにぎやか。

cultural_comfort.note: Small plates you can point at; obanzai on the counter; lively with regulars.

existence.note: Official site live; Tabelog reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_assiette_dessert_mikan.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: plated desserts with chiffon, puff pastry, tortellini, financiers and madeleines (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_assiette_dessert_mikan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: ice creams, cream, mousse, panna cotta and butter pastries (reviews).
kyoto_assiette_dessert_mikan.hours_raw: Official site: reservations only, courses starting together — lunch 12:00 full course and 15:00 short course; dinner 19:30 course, à la carte 19:00–21:00 with petits fours; closes 22:00; irregular closing days (calendar on Instagram) (Tabelog lists 13:00, 15:00 and 19:30). May be closed when there are no bookings (Tabelog). A charge on top at lunch and dinner — ¥500 from August 2021 (official site); one drink per person (official site; Tabelog 「ワンドリンク制」). Cancellation: 50% within 48 hours, 100% within 24 hours (official site). 7 counter seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Opened 22 September 2017 (Tabelog; official site).
kyoto_assiette_dessert_mikan.notes: [Dessert course · seven-seat counter, plated desserts made in front of you] A reservation-only dessert counter north of the Kyoto City Hall area, open since 2017: chef 大村 壮史 builds a course of plated desserts in front of seven guests — citrus, peach, or a once-a-year chestnut course — ending with mignardises and warm financiers. Full course ¥6,600, short course ¥5,500, plus a drink and a charge. 100% cancellation fee within 24 hours.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: made cream puffs and café desserts at Crème de la Crème (2004–2006); wedding and café cakes at スター株式会社 (2006–2008); restaurant desserts and take-out cakes at Il Ghiottone (2008–2013); chocolate café desserts at マリベル (2013–2014); wedding cakes and desserts at the Westin Miyako Hotel (2014–2017); then opened Mikan in September 2017 as an assiette-dessert shop. An April 2026 regular calls it a pioneer of dessert courses in Kyoto that has kept its prices modest.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: the name 未完 ("unfinished") means 「現状に満足せず、常に新しい技術やデザインを追求し続ける」 — never satisfied, always chasing new techniques and designs; desserts to enjoy with all five senses.
chef_bio.specialty: Assiette dessert course; seasonal parfait.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 regular: "When I try to find a similar dessert course in Tokyo, it can cost three to four times as much."
The once-a-year chestnut course ran three days in November 2025; its parfait alone had about a dozen components, from hojicha espuma to Tanba chestnut ice cream.
The same April 2026 regular found the short course good but felt "the true value of this restaurant shines through in their regular full course."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-mikan.jp): アシェットデセール 未完、完全予約制のデザートのコース、店名は「現状に満足せず、常に新しい技術やデザインを追求し続ける」という意味、カウンター席のみ、五感で楽しむ、シェフ 大村 壮史 (クレームデラクレーム、スター株式会社、イルギオットーネ、マリベル、ウェスティン都ホテルを経て2017年9月に開業)、コース 全9皿お土産付き 6,600円 (税込)、ワンドリンクオーダー、昼12:00フルコース・15:00ショートコース、夜19:30コース・アラカルト19:00〜21:00、22:00閉店、昼夜ともにチャージ料 (2021年8月から500円)、不定休、キャンセルは48時間以内50%・24時間以内100%。食べログ: ケーキ・カフェ、中京区御幸町通夷川上る松本町583-1 フォルム御幸町 1F、7席、ワンドリンク制、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2017年9月22日オープン、予約がない日は休みの場合あり。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): ウェルカムのハーブティー、ぶどう、丹波栗と洋梨、ピスタチオのシフォン、年に一度の栗のコース (3日間)、柑橘のコース、桃のコース、ショートコース5,500円、白味噌のフィナンシェ、生姜のマドレーヌ、東京なら3〜4倍の値段、京都のデザートコースの草分け。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online; a set course explained at the counter.

existence.note: Official site live with online booking; Tabelog reviews dated through October 2026.
