kyoto_tempura_darukin.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: an omakase of wheat-batter tempura (official site; reviews).
kyoto_tempura_darukin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish and seafood tempura, sea urchin, a dashi chazuke to finish (reviews).
kyoto_tempura_darukin.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: daily 18:00–23:00, reservation only, two seatings starting together at 18:00 and 20:00; closed irregularly. Cancellations or changes in numbers at least two days before. Payment by credit card only — no cash (Tabelog; official site; March 2024). No children except when the shop is booked privately (Tabelog). 7 counter seats (Tabelog; the official site also says six, one turn); non-smoking. Opened April 2019 (official site).
kyoto_tempura_darukin.notes: [Tempura · near Shijo-Karasuma, an oden master’s tempura] A seven-seat counter near Shijo-Karasuma opened in 2019 by the owner of the oden shop だるまときんぎょ, who asked why tempura always uses the same ingredients: 18-month-aged potatoes, chutoro hand rolls, zucchini with Parmigiano, a firefly-squid chazuke. Two seatings, 18:00 and 20:00, all start together. Cards only, no cash. No children unless booked privately.

roles: Owner-chef (official site); also runs the oden shop だるまときんぎょ
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the owner of the oden shop だるまときんぎょ opened Darukin in April 2019 out of a wish to widen what tempura can use, starting from the question of why tempura ingredients are always the same; it has become a word-of-mouth hideaway near Karasuma, with art on the walls and a mirror-finished frying station. A February 2022 diner saw the owner running everything alone while still explaining the sake; a March 2024 diner met the chef’s wife at the counter.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「なぜ天ぷらの食材はいつも同じなのか」 — why are tempura ingredients always the same?
chef_bio.specialty: 18-month-aged potato tempura; nori with scallop and sea urchin.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner asked other shops why they all fry the same things — "Because they are delicious" — and found Darukin "challenging that perspective."

March 2024: next to the diner sat a woman in red tights, tiger-print trousers, a red turtleneck and a red tiger cap, with red hair and eyebrows — "She was so charming, and it turned out she was the chef’s wife!"
"Although the owner was busy managing everything alone, he provided thorough explanations of the sake pairings during the meal." — February 2022.
August 2021: the course starts for everyone together, and the diners waited about 15 minutes for a late group — "That was a bit disappointing."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (tempuradarukin.com): 天ぷら だるきん、京都・綾小路堺町、旬の素材の天ぷらのおまかせコース、一回転のみ6席のカウンター、「なぜ天ぷらの食材はいつも同じなのか」から出発した大将、18ヶ月熟成キタアカリ、どんちっちアジ、中トロ、のどぐろ、ズッキーニ×パルメジャーノ、海苔に貝柱と雲丹の手渡しの一品、7席、完全予約制・2部制 (18時と20時)、クレジットカード決済のみ、おでん屋「だるまときんぎょ」の大将が2019年4月に開業、伊藤 大輔、18ヶ月熟成じゃがいもを1時間半かけて調理、月〜日 18:00〜23:00、キャンセル・人数変更は2日前まで。食べログ: 天ぷら・日本料理、下京区堺町通綾小路下ル綾材木町198-5、阪急烏丸駅15番出口から徒歩3分、予約のみ、7席、カードのみ、子供は貸切時のみ、禁煙。口コミ (2021〜2026年、英語): 揚げる音、軽い衣、鰆、人参、蓮根、芽キャベツとペコリーノ、ほたるいかの出汁茶漬け、フルーツトマト、一人で切り盛りしながら日本酒の説明 (2022年)、大将の奥さん (2024年)、遅れた組を15分待った (2021年)、1人1万〜2万円ほど。

cultural_comfort.note: Omakase only; book ahead; cards only.

existence.note: Official site live; Tabelog reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_bistro_wine_espace.gf_detail: Ask. House brioche, pâté and hachis parmentier sit beside carpaccio, grilled fish and steak; no gluten information (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_bistro_wine_espace.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat and fish bistro, though dishes come with many vegetables (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_bistro_wine_espace.hours_raw: 12:00–14:30 (last orders food 13:45, drinks 14:00) and 17:00–24:00 (last food order 23:00); closed Wednesday and 1–2 other days a month (Tabelog). Lunch is a course only (October 2026 review). Bookings taken, but not for 17:00–20:00 apéro visits; guests who do not drink alcohol pay a ¥500 seat charge (Tabelog). Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「チャージなし」. Adults (20+) only. 9 counter seats; non-smoking; cards and IC cards (Tabelog). The owner-chef works alone, so dishes can take time (2025 reviews). 3 min from Sanjo Keihan Stn exits 1–2 (Tabelog).
kyoto_bistro_wine_espace.notes: [Bistro & natural wine · Sanjo Keihan] A nine-seat counter where one chef cooks seasonal bistro plates — brioche with fig butter, pâté, sardine confit, beef cheek in red wine — and pours natural wines. Lunch is a course; dinner runs to midnight, about ¥6,000–9,000. Adults only; non-drinkers pay ¥500. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 May 2022 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe the owner-chef working solo (January, March and November 2025); a June 2026 diner came from Gifu after a post by the chef's wife on Instagram.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal bistro dishes; natural wine.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 diner wrote of "a handsome owner" recommending red, white and orange wines at the counter.
A January 2025 table found ordering everything at once, course-style, a bit hectic with one person serving.
A November 2024 diner wished the solo owner-chef smiled a little more, but found the cooking meticulous and the value great.
An October 2026 lunch guest was disappointed that the house sausage was not preservative-free.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): Bistro&Wine espace、ビストロ・ダイニングバー・居酒屋、東山区二町目50 サンラック東山 1F、三条京阪駅1・2番出口から徒歩3分、12:00〜14:30・17:00〜24:00、水曜休み (ほか月1〜2回不定休)、17〜20時のアペロ利用の予約不可、お酒を飲まない方は席料500円、チャージなし、20歳以上のみ、カウンター9席、2022年5月1日オープン、牛ほほ肉の4日漬け赤ワイン煮、自家製ソーセージ、自然派ワイン。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 店主シェフが一人で営む、ブリオッシュといちじくバター、パテ・ド・カンパーニュ、柿と魚のカルパッチョ、イワシのコンフィ、アッシ・パルマンティエ、昼はコースのみ、ハウスワインのボトル4,000円、ソーセージが無添加でないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter only, adults only; ask the chef for recommendations.

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_yatai_inaba.gf_detail: Ask. Soy-based oden broth with chikuwa, fu and gyoza among the items; kara-age and tempura are battered (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_yatai_inaba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden in dashi broth, kara-age, fish cakes (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_yatai_inaba.hours_raw: Thu 18:00–23:00; Fri and Sat 18:00–24:00; closed Sun–Wed; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings taken, advised — often full, and walk-ins get turned away (2025–26 reviews). 13 seats: 7 at the counter, tables for 2 and 4; you stand to let people pass to the restroom (Tabelog; January 2026 review). No cards; PayPay (Tabelog). Non-smoking. Late in the evening some dishes sell out (January 2026 review). 400 m from Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_yatai_inaba.notes: [Oden counter · south of Shijo-Karasuma] A tiny, cheerful oden bar open three nights a week: broth-soaked daikon and potatoes, battered pickled ginger, huge garlicky kara-age and a potato salad made from the oden pot. About ¥2,000–3,500. Thu–Sat from 18:00; book, it fills up.

chef_bio.background: A January 2026 reviewer writes that it began as Kyoto's oldest food stall, loved for 60 years, removed in 2023 despite a petition after a police request to vacate, and revived indoors by devoted fans.
chef_bio.specialty: Oden; kara-age; oden potato salad.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 regular called the owner always kind and the squid-shiokara potato salad good enough to copy at home.
When a party of three had to change its booking time in October 2025, the owner's flexibility touched the group.
A March 2026 regular has twice been turned away on full nights.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 屋台いなば、おでん、下京区東洞院通高辻下ル燈籠町592-1、四条駅から403m、木 18:00〜23:00、金土 18:00〜24:00、日月火水休み、予約可、13席 (カウンター7、テーブル2席・4席)、禁煙、カード不可、PayPay 可。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年7月、英語): やさしい少し甘い出汁のおでん (大根、玉子、厚揚げ、車麩、じゃがいも、豆腐、ちくわ、たこ、ロールキャベツ、しらたき、餃子、海老焼売)、紅しょうがの天ぷら、にんにく醤油のもも唐揚げ、えのきの唐揚げ、舞茸の天ぷら、おでんのじゃがいもと玉子のポテサラ (明太子・いかの塩辛)、Sapporo Akaboshi、クラフトビール、日本酒、京都最古の屋台が2023年に撤去され復活したという話、店主が親切、満席で断られることも。

cultural_comfort.note: Tiny, busy oden counter for regulars; book ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_kuji_goji.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta, bread and hot sandwiches beside omelettes, carpaccio and steamed chicken; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kuji_goji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: whitebait omelette, carpaccio, chicken and clam dishes, though vegetables feature (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kuji_goji.hours_raw: Tue, Wed, Fri and Sat 9:00–17:00; closed Mon, Thu and Sun; irregular days on Instagram (Tabelog). Drinkers only — Tabelog: "Not available if no alcohol is ordered. Non-alcoholic drinks are also not allowed." A June 2026 diner noted a sign at the entrance turning away those not drinking alcohol. No bookings: leave your name and phone number and the shop calls when a seat opens; people queue before 9:00 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cash only (Tabelog). 8 counter seats, a table for 4 and some standing room; children welcome (Tabelog; May 2026 review). 10 min from Gojo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_kuji_goji.notes: [Daytime Italian & drinks · near Gojo] Named for its hours, nine to five: a bright counter for morning and afternoon drinking with seasonal Italian plates — shirasu omelette with sansho oil, ginger chicken, carpaccio, clam pasta. You must order alcohol; no bookings, leave your number and wait nearby. About ¥3,000–6,000; cash only. Open Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat.

chef_bio.background: Opened 15 December 2019 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Shirasu omelette with sansho oil; seasonal small plates.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 couple sharing one pasta found it already split into two plates, but felt the "no entry for those not drinking alcohol" sign might put some guests off, and the lunch prices a little high.
Ordering "two beers" in July 2026, a guest was asked, "Since it's bottled beer, shall I bring one for now?"
A September 2026 visitor was first in line 30 minutes before the 9:00 opening; three more groups queued soon after.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 九時五時 (Kuji Goji)、イタリアン・洋菓子、下京区栄町514、五条駅から徒歩10分、火水金土 9:00〜17:00、月木日休み (不定休は Instagram で告知)、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター8席とテーブル4人1卓、子供可、2019年12月15日オープン、お酒を注文しない方は利用不可 (ノンアルコールも不可)。口コミ (2026年3〜9月、英語): 朝から飲める、名前と電話番号を残して呼び出し、しらすのオムレツ山椒オイル、蒸し鶏の生姜ソース、イサキのカルパッチョ、conger eel の湯引き、ハードパンのホットサンド、あさりのパスタ、明太子と大葉のパスタ、瓶ビールは Sapporo Black Label のみ、サングリア、焼き菓子、価格は高めという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Alcohol order required (Tabelog); no bookings — leave a phone number at the door.

kyoto_wagyu_panga_gion_shijo.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled wagyu with a sweet-savoury sauce over rice, wagyu cutlet, sukiyaki bowl, red miso soup; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_wagyu_panga_gion_shijo.hours_raw: 12:30–15:00 (last orders food 14:00, drinks 14:30) and 17:00–22:00 (last orders food 21:00, drinks 21:30), daily (Tabelog). Bookings via TableCheck (Tabelog; TableCheck). Halal: the operator's Tabelog text says the wagyu comes "with Halal Certification", without naming a certifier; TableCheck calls the dishes "halal-friendly"; a September 2026 diner saw a prayer room. English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese menus with photos; staff speaking English, Chinese and Korean — reviewers found the staff all from overseas (Tabelog; October 2026 reviews). 30 seats, tables and counter; non-smoking; cards, IC, PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 3F of the building just left of Minamiza, steps from Gion-Shijo Stn exit 6 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_wagyu_panga_gion_shijo.notes: [Wagyu hitsumabushi · beside Minamiza, Gion-Shijo] A bright third-floor room by the Minamiza theatre serving A5 wagyu hitsumabushi three ways — plain, with wasabi and shiso, then in kombu dashi — from ¥3,800 for 110 g of lean. Multilingual staff and menus; the operator states the wagyu is halal-certified (certifier not named). Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Opened 9 March 2025 (Tabelog). Part of the PANGA wagyu group: a September 2026 reviewer calls it affiliated with The WAGYU BURGER by PANGA, whose site traces the brand to a Tokyo wagyu yakiniku shop founded in 1999; a sister 和牛すき焼き 京都 ぱんが also operates in Kyoto.
chef_bio.philosophy: Only the top 4% of A5 black wagyu, bought as whole cattle (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu hitsumabushi.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner paid ¥1,800 for the 110 g lean hitsumabushi set and was served politely by a staff member from overseas still learning Japanese; other 2026 reviews give ¥3,800 for the same set.
An October 2026 guest got free matcha after the meal and caramels from the staff.
An October 2026 diner noted the many inbound guests and the friendly, English-speaking staff from overseas.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 和牛ぱんが 祇園四条店、日本料理・丼・肉料理、東山区中之町206 志満家ビル 3F、祇園四条駅6番出口すぐ、12:30〜15:00・17:00〜22:00、無休、30席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、英語・中国語のメニュー、英語・中国語・韓国語のスタッフ、2025年3月9日オープン、A5ランクの上位4%の黒毛和牛を一頭買い、ハラール認証 (認証機関の記載なし)、ひつまぶし御膳、牛カツ御膳、A5和牛スタンダードコース7品。TableCheck: 赤身ひつまぶし110g 3,800円・150g 5,000円、サーロイン110g 5,500円・150g 7,500円 (税込)、ハラールフレンドリー。口コミ (2026年9〜11月、英語): Minami-za の左隣のビル3階、そのまま・薬味・出汁茶漬けの三通り、赤だし、食後の抹茶、礼拝室、海外出身のスタッフ、The WAGYU BURGER by PANGA の系列。

cultural_comfort.note: English and Chinese menus with photos; English-, Chinese- and Korean-speaking staff (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop and TableCheck; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_beer_komachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a craft beer bar whose food includes gyoza, karaage, chicken tempura, spring rolls and pizza (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_beer_komachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden in dashi, sausages, lamb spring rolls, sashimi (2024–26 reviews). No vegan information.
kyoto_beer_komachi.hours_raw: Mon, Wed–Fri 17:00–23:00, Sat–Sun 15:00–23:00, closed Tuesday, per a JW Web Magazine guide (published February 2017, updated August 2025); Tabelog lists no hours and the shop has changed hands (April 2025 and January 2026 reviews), so check before going. Reservations accepted, and advised for groups and for low-table seats (Tabelog; July 2024). No service charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス・チャージ料なし」). Cards (VISA, Master, AMEX) and QR, no e-money (Tabelog). 20 seats: about 4 at the counter, the rest at tables (Tabelog; February 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). In the Furukawa-cho shopping street, 1 min from Higashiyama Stn exit 2 (Tabelog).
kyoto_beer_komachi.notes: [Craft beer · Furukawa-cho arcade by Higashiyama Stn, beer with Japanese plates] A lantern-lit bar in the old Furukawa-cho arcade with about eight taps of Japanese craft beer and food reviewers rate as highly as the beer — gyoza, chicken tempura with matcha salt, a fried-tofu pizza, oden. Now run by the former cook, often alone. Plenty of overseas visitors and regulars. Hours come from a 2025 guide, not the shop; check before going.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), who took over when the previous owner retired (January 2026)
chef_bio.background: A January 2026 regular of more than ten years says the previous owner retired and the long-time cook took over; an April 2025 review heard that the owner of the former Shokudo Yasukichi in Kitakujo had taken over. A February 2026 group found the owner running the place alone.
chef_bio.specialty: Japanese craft beer on tap; dishes that pair with it.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 regular of over ten years credits the cook with dishes that taste magical using only ordinary supermarket seasonings.
An April 2026 first-timer, in town for a concert, was lent a plastic umbrella by the owner when it rained.
A May 2025 regular noted beer prices up by about a quarter since the last visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイニングバー・ビアバー、東山区八軒町444 古川町商店街、東山駅2番出口から徒歩1分、営業時間の記載なし、予約可、サービス・チャージ料なし、カード (VISA・Master・AMEX)・QR 可、20席、禁煙。JW Web Magazine (2017年2月掲載、2025年8月更新): 平日17:00〜23:00、土日15:00〜23:00、火曜休み。口コミ (2024年7月〜2026年4月、英語): 国産クラフトビール約8タップ、ハーフパイント890円、飲み比べ、餃子、唐揚げ、鶏の天ぷらと抹茶塩、赤こんにゃくのおでん、ラムとチェダーの春巻き780円、油揚げのピザ、ソーセージ、前の店主が引退し料理人が後を継いだ (2026年1月)、店主が一人で営む (2026年2月)、外国人の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Choose from the day’s taps at the counter; many overseas visitors and regulars (2025–26 reviews). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through April 2026.

kyoto_house_of_kinobi.gf_detail: Ask. A gin bar with light snacks — smoked nuts, black soybean sweets, saba sushi (2026 reviews); Tabelog says allergy information is available.
kyoto_house_of_kinobi.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; one cocktail uses gin infused with duck fat (January 2026).
kyoto_house_of_kinobi.hours_raw: Wed, Thu, Sun 15:00–21:00 (last order 20:30); Fri, Sat 15:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Monday and Tuesday (Tabelog). A January 2026 reviewer noted opening from 14:00. Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「チャージ料無し」). Cards and e-money, no QR (Tabelog). Counter, sofa seats and a standing area in a renovated machiya; private hire up to 50 (Tabelog; October 2025). Non-smoking; English menu (Tabelog). On Kawaramachi north of Nijo; 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn exit 16 (Tabelog). Opened 1 June 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_house_of_kinobi.notes: [Gin bar · Kawaramachi Nijo, the KI NO BI distillery’s machiya] The Kyoto Distillery’s own bar in a renovated townhouse, with stills on display: taste three KI NO BI gins for ¥1,800, or try a matcha tonic, the bourbon-scented Edition K or a martini that brings out the yuzu and sansho. Bartenders explain each gin and will suggest drinks. No cover charge; bottles to take home. Many overseas guests. 15:00 until 21:00 or 22:00; closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: the bar run directly by the Kyoto Distillery, maker of KI NO BI gin, opened 1 June 2020 in a renovated machiya, with distilling equipment on display (July 2026), a tasting counter, sofas and a standing area.
chef_bio.specialty: KI NO BI gin tastings; matcha tonic.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor with almost no gin knowledge got thorough explanations and a three-gin tasting at ¥1,800.
An August 2026 visitor wanted mixed drinks rather than the straight tasting pours, and had the champagne-cask Edition G with soda instead.
An August 2026 visitor was surprised there was no cover charge, and stayed for three drinks.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バー、中京区河原町通二条上ル清水町358、京都市役所前駅16番出口から徒歩5分、水木日15:00〜21:00 (L.O. 20:30)、金土15:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、月火休み、予約可、チャージ料無し、カード・電子マネー可、貸切50名まで、禁煙、英語メニュー、ベジタリアンメニューあり、アレルギー表示あり、2020年6月1日オープン。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年11月、英語): Kyoto Distillery の直営、町家の改装、KI NO BI の3種飲み比べ1,800円、抹茶トニック1,800円、Edition K 1,000円、鴨の脂を移したジンのカクテル、燻製ナッツ、黒豆の菓子、鯖寿司、外国人の客が多い、丁寧な説明。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); many overseas guests and bartenders who explain each gin (2026 reviews). No cover charge.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026. The official page blocked the fetch (Cloudflare) on 2026-11-06.

kyoto_rokujuan.gf_detail: Ask. The hanawarabi is the shop’s own blend (official site), served with kinako and black syrup; duck rice porridge and a dinner course with sukiyaki and nigiri (official site). No gluten information.
kyoto_rokujuan.vegan_detail: Ask. The warabi mochi, kakigori and tea look plant-based, but no ingredient information; the porridge is cooked in duck broth (official site).
kyoto_rokujuan.hours_raw: Café Mon, Thu–Sun and holidays 8:00–21:30, Tue–Wed 8:00–20:00, last order 19:00 (official site; Tabelog). Dinner omakase in two sittings, 17:00–19:00 and 19:30–21:30, not on Tuesday or Wednesday; reservation and advance payment required (official site; Tabelog). Café bookings via TableCheck, with an optional short tour of the house (September and October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, AMEX), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 30 seats, tatami; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). Photos allowed, no flash (October 2026). On Rokkaku west of Shinmachi; 4 min from Shijo and Karasuma Stns (Tabelog). Opened 1 March 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_rokujuan.notes: [Café and dinner omakase · Rokkaku Shinmachi, a painter’s Taisho house] A 1914 residence, home of the painter 今尾景年 and now a registered cultural property, turned café: clear "hanawarabi" studded with edible flowers (¥2,000 with matcha), kakigori and duck porridge, with garden views and a short tour of the house if you book. A seven-dish omakase with sukiyaki and nigiri runs at dinner, prepaid. From 8:00 daily.

roles: Head chef (unnamed), who finishes the dinner sukiyaki and nigiri in front of guests (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the house is the Kubo family residence (旧今尾景年宅), a registered tangible cultural property built in 1914 (大正3年) by 今尾景年, a Shijo-school painter of the Meiji and Taisho eras, who spent the later years of life there. The dinner omakase began on 10 March 2025. Opened 1 March 2023 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Hanawarabi (flower warabi mochi).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 visitor booked a day ahead, joined the optional mini tour of the house and found it the unexpected highlight.
An October 2026 visitor at 9:00 on a weekday noted that earlier bookings get the window seats over the garden.
An October 2026 visitor admired the Taisho-era glass and old garden stones on the tour while waiting for a seat.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 有形文化財 久保家住宅 (旧今尾景年宅)、大正3年築、四条派の日本画家 今尾景年が晩年を過ごした家、華わらび (エディブルフラワー、自家製黒蜜と国産きな粉)、金木犀の華わらび (9月末〜11月末)、桜わらび、抹茶とほうじ茶のかき氷、紀州鴨の鴨茶粥、夜は京野菜と季節の食材の全7品のおまかせ (すき焼きと握り寿司を料理長が目の前で、2025年3月から、予約制・先払い)、カフェ 月木金土日 8:00〜21:30・火水 8:00〜20:00 (L.O. 19:00)、ディナー17:00〜19:00・19:30〜21:30 (火水なし)。食べログ: 甘味処、中京区六角通新町西入西六角町101、30席、座敷、カード可、2023年3月1日オープン。口コミ (2026年9月〜11月、英語): TableCheck で予約、建物の案内、華わらびと抹茶2,000円、フラッシュ禁止。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online through TableCheck; staff guide you round the house before seating (2026 reviews). Dinner is prepaid. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_sakenoateya_jijibaba.gf_detail: Ask. Creative small plates including mapo tofu with baguette, shrimp toast and tacos (2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_sakenoateya_jijibaba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: prosciutto, sausages, offal, lamb and fish dishes; the set appetizer includes cheese tofu (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sakenoateya_jijibaba.hours_raw: 18:00–2:00; closed Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; QR accepted (Tabelog). 11 counter seats, tight enough that passing behind is hard (Tabelog; May 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Run by one person, so service can be slow (November 2025; May 2026). An appetizer is served (May and October 2026). In the Rido dining alley, 100 m west of Karasuma Shichijo on the south side; 6 min from Kyoto Stn central exit (Tabelog). The restroom is old (November 2025, January 2026).
kyoto_sakenoateya_jijibaba.notes: [Izakaya · Rido alley by Kyoto Stn, one cook’s creative counter] A tiny counter in the Showa-era Rido dining alley where the owner, alone, slices prosciutto off the block and turns out kiwi caprese, mapo tofu with baguette, lamb tataki and homemade raisin butter, with good shochu and wine. Cramped, smoking allowed, and slow when full; one May 2026 diner found portions small for the price. Cash or QR. 18:00–2:00; closed Sunday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), who runs the counter alone (2025–26 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an 11-seat counter izakaya in the Rido dining alley off Shichijo. Reviews from November 2025, February 2026 and May 2026 say the owner runs it alone.
chef_bio.specialty: Prosciutto; creative small plates.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 diner enjoyed watching the owner slice the block of prosciutto, which had a nutty, woody aroma.
A February 2026 diner, the only man among mostly women guests, never felt the one-person service was a drawback.
A May 2026 diner paid just under ¥8,000 for four dishes and drinks and thought the portions small and the menu short.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイニングバー・創作料理・居酒屋、下京区七条通烏丸西入ル東境町180 リド飲食街内、京都駅中央口から徒歩6分、18:00〜翌2:00、日祝休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可・QR 可、カウンター11席、喫煙可。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 店主が一人で営む、生ハムの塊、キウイのカプレーゼ、鯛の昆布締め、じじばばタコス、山芋とチーズのオムレツ、バゲット付きの麻婆豆腐、自家製レーズンバター、ホルモンの煮込み、ラムのたたき、砂肝の唐揚げ、焼酎、レモンサワー、量が少なめとの声、トイレが古い。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk in and take a counter seat; one person cooks and serves; smoking allowed; pay cash or QR, no cards. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_konoshima_beer.gf_detail: Not GF: a draft-beer bar of barley beers; the snack is popcorn (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_konoshima_beer.vegan_detail: Ask. Beer and popcorn only, with no ingredient information; a curry from the restaurant upstairs is sometimes offered (July 2025).
kyoto_konoshima_beer.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 14:00–22:00; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). A charge of ¥200 per person (Tabelog original 200円/1名), which brings the popcorn otoshi (2026 reviews). 7 counter seats plus standing room and a small terrace; non-smoking (Tabelog; January 2026). Children welcome, but no phone videos or game consoles (Tabelog). Cards, transit IC, iD, QUICPay, PayPay, d Barai, au PAY (Tabelog). 1F of the Sanjo Shirakawabashi building on Sanjo-dori, below ひがしやま 司; 3 min walk from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; March 2024). Opened 20 June 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_konoshima_beer.notes: [Beer bar · Sanjo Shirakawabashi by Higashiyama Stn] A pared-back seven-seat counter with plaster walls and five gleaming taps, pouring Sapporo draughts — SORACHI 1984, Edel Pils, Ebisu black — with care, from small 180 ml glasses, plus a peppery popcorn that guests rave about. The owner, an architect and Kyoto native, chats about the neighbourhood and where to eat next. A ¥200 seat charge. Afternoons and evenings; closed Monday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), an architect and Kyoto native (as reviewers describe)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 20 June 2020. Reviewers describe a narrow bar designed by its architect owner (May 2026), taps cleaned thoroughly every day (December 2025), events and a collaboration with ひがしやま 司 on the floor above (December 2025), an owner who knows the nearby restaurants (August 2024), and a Kyoto-born master who shared festival stories (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Carefully poured Sapporo draught; pepper popcorn.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 regular turned up at 13:30, before opening, and was kindly let in anyway.
A July 2026 visitor heard from the Kyoto-born master that the Gion Festival really comes alive at night, and that the Abare Kannon is quite exciting.
A January 2026 guest asked how the pepper popcorn is made, and concluded it is best enjoyed at the bar.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ビアバー・バー、東山区西町127 三条白川橋ビル 1F、地下鉄東山駅から徒歩3分、火〜日 14:00〜22:00、月曜定休、予約不可、チャージ200円/1名、7席 (カウンター、立ち飲みも)、禁煙、子ども可 (スマホの動画やゲーム機は不可)、カード・交通系IC・iD・QUICPay・PayPay・d払い・au PAY 可、2020年6月20日オープン。口コミ (2024年3月〜2026年7月、英語): サッポロの生ビール5種 (SORACHI 1984、Edel Pils、Black Label、Kohaku Ebisu、Ebisu Premium Black、Ebisu Meister)、ハーフ&ハーフ、180ml から3サイズ、SORACHI 180ml 550円、ハーフ&ハーフ 300ml 850円、500ml 850〜1,100円、お通しのポップコーン (胡椒)、2階のひがしやま 司のカレー、毎日タップを洗浄、建築家の店主、京都出身のマスター、店主と客の会話、漆喰の壁、テラス。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; ¥200 charge with popcorn; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through July 2026.

kyoto_kappou_kita_tenmusu.gf_detail: Not GF: tempura in wheat batter, dipped in a sauce of dashi, soy sauce, mirin and sugar (Tabelog).
kyoto_kappou_kita_tenmusu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood tempura rice balls with a dashi sauce, and a fish-led evening kappo (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kappou_kita_tenmusu.hours_raw: Wednesday–Monday 10:00–14:00 (tenmusu, lunch only) and 17:00–22:30 (kappo); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Lunch tenmusu are fried to order, three pieces minimum, and sell out — come early (May 2025; July 2024). Reservations accepted; private hire possible (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards or e-money (Tabelog). 7 counter seats; non-smoking; takeaway in bamboo-leaf wraps and baskets (Tabelog). On the ground floor of an apartment building in the Matsubara Kyogoku shopping street near Gojo Tenjin Shrine; 9 min walk from Gojo Stn (Tabelog; August 2024). Opened 9 August 2017 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kappou_kita_tenmusu.notes: [Tenmusu and kappo · Matsubara Kyogoku near Gojo Tenjin] A seven-seat counter with two lives. From 10:00, Kyoto-style tenmusu fried to order — plump shrimp, sea bream, anago, seasonal matsutake or crab — dipped in a sweet-savoury dashi sauce, ¥300 each, three or more, with a dashimaki that sells out. At night, an unpretentious kappo of sashimi, house karasumi and seasonal plates from a Gion-trained chef. Takeaway in bamboo leaf. Cash only; closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), trained at a noted Gion restaurant (August 2024 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 9 August 2017; Kyoto-style tempura rice balls from a Japanese-cuisine chef, with rice cooked in a hangiri and a house sauce of dashi, soy sauce, mirin and sugar; registered as an official listing by the shop. An August 2024 reviewer writes that the owner trained at a prestigious Gion restaurant and runs the shop independently, serving tenmusu by day and kaiseki by night, and that the tenmusu was inspired by backstage visits to geisha.
chef_bio.philosophy: Light batter to bring out the ingredients (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Tenmusu; dashimaki.

anecdotes.text: An August 2024 reviewer titled the visit "Tenmusu inspired by backstage visits to geisha".
A Sunday in March 2026 saw several takeaway orders, likely for cherry-blossom picnics; a late-breakfast guest had firefly-squid tenmusu.
A December 2024 regular, coming often since the opening, ate monkfish with ponzu, buri ham, house karasumi and a tempura rice bowl.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: おにぎり・天ぷら・日本料理、下京区天神前町340、五条駅から徒歩9分、水〜月 10:00〜14:00・17:00〜22:30、火曜定休、天むすは昼のみ、予約可、貸切可、カード・電子マネー不可、7席 (カウンター)、禁煙、テイクアウト、2017年8月9日オープン。店の紹介: 松原京極商店街の「Tenmusu Kita」、和食の料理人の京風の天むす、hangiri を使うご飯、素材を生かす薄衣、だしに醤油・みりん・砂糖の自家製のたれ、季節の天むす (秋は松茸と秋鮭、冬は蟹、春は筍)、ときに牛ヒレ、笹と籠の持ち帰り。口コミ (2024年7月〜2026年3月、英語): 五条天神の近く、賃貸マンションの1階、祇園の名店で修業した店主、昼は天むす、夜は割烹、天むすは1個300円・3個から、注文後に揚げる、海老、鯛、いか、穴子、鮭、きす、明太子、鮎、ほたるいか、だし巻きはすぐ売り切れ、夜は無花果の煮物、Mibuna のサラダ、お造り、燻製のいわし、アンコウのポン酢、ぶりのハム、自家製のからすみ、鯛の子、天丼。

cultural_comfort.note: Order three or more tenmusu at the counter; takeaway wraps; cash only.

existence.note: Official Tabelog listing; reviews through March 2026.

kyoto_casa_bianca_imadegawa.gf_detail: Not GF: the lunch and dinner courses centre on pasta, lasagna and bread (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_casa_bianca_imadegawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses with seafood, horse tartare, veal, cheese and dairy desserts (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_casa_bianca_imadegawa.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–21:30; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); walk-ins usually fine at weekday lunch (2025 reviews). 60 seats incl. a counter; non-smoking; parking (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money (Tabelog). An old house with high ceilings, blue tablecloths and characterful chairs, on Imadegawa-dori west of Teramachi; about 570 m from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog; August–September 2025).
kyoto_casa_bianca_imadegawa.notes: [Italian · Imadegawa Teramachi, near the Imperial Palace] A spacious, high-ceilinged Italian in an old house, with blue tablecloths and quirky chairs, long a local favourite. The ¥2,600 pasta lunch is the draw — antipasti, bread, pasta such as carbonara or a cheesy lasagna, dessert and espresso — with omakase courses of carpaccio, pasta and veal or fish at night. Most praise the value and service; one 2025 guest felt rushed as plates were cleared. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a 60-seat Italian on Imadegawa-dori west of Teramachi with parking. Reviewers in 2025–2026 call it a popular, long-known Italian among Kyoto locals (July 2026), in an old building used to good effect (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Pasta lunch; lasagna.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 guest who returned for the lasagna felt hurried as plates — even the dessert fruit — were cleared before finishing, and vowed not to return.
A September 2026 visitor who stopped nearby to buy pickles ended up lunching here, and found the service attentive.
At a February 2026 family gathering the staff kept offering refills of four breads, one apparently made with beets.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン、上京区今出川通寺町西入ル大原口214、出町柳駅から572m、火〜日 11:30〜14:00・17:00〜21:30、月曜定休、予約可、60席、カウンター、禁煙、駐車場あり、カード可、電子マネー不可。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年9月、英語): 御所の近く、古い建物、高い天井、青いテーブルクロス、パスタランチ2,600円 (前菜の盛り合わせ、パン、パスタ、デザート、エスプレッソ)、カルボナーラ、ラザニア、冷製のトマトのパスタ、魚のランチコース、馬肉のタルタル、たこのオーブン焼き、魚介のアラビアータ、おまかせ (鯛とからすみのカルパッチョ、帆立と海老、きのこのカルボナーラ、スズキのトマトソースか仔牛のグリル、デザートの盛り合わせ)、ビーツのパン、お皿を下げるのが早かったとの声 (2025年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Set lunches; book for dinner; cards; parking.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through September 2026.

kyoto_casa_bianca_imadegawa.pin_source: GSI 京都府京都市上京区大原口町214番地 (lot) (35.029041, 135.767288), used instead of the Tabelog pin https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260302/26001025/ (35.029035, 135.767213), which sits 3 m from kyoto_eze_bleu (Casa Bianca building, 212); the GSI lot is 7 m from the Tabelog pin and 5.4 m from eze bleu; 2026-11-06

kyoto_noto_sho_matsubara.gf_detail: Not GF: eel grilled with a sweet-savoury tare and river-fish dishes; no gluten information (2014–2026 reviews).
kyoto_noto_sho_matsubara.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a river-fish shop of eel, ayu, shijimi and dashimaki (2014–2026 reviews).
kyoto_noto_sho_matsubara.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 9:00–19:00; closed Sunday, Monday when a holiday, and occasionally (Tabelog). Takeaway only — no seats (Tabelog). Reservations (orders) accepted (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). On Matsubara-dori just west of Yamato-oji; 5 min walk from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn or the Kawaramachi Matsubara bus stop (Tabelog).
kyoto_noto_sho_matsubara.notes: [Eel takeaway · Matsubara-dori near Kenninji] A small family river-fish shop, three generations in, grilling Kansai-style eel in the window: generous unagi bento and unadon to go, whole kabayaki, unagi-maki, Yawata-maki and dashimaki, plus Lake Biwa ayu and honmoroko when in season. A neighbourhood fish-market feel; locals buy for New Year and dinner at home. Takeaway only. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a takeaway shop of side dishes, delicatessen and eel on Matsubara-dori; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers describe a specialist in river fish with tanks of live ayu, mostly from Lake Biwa and Shiga (September 2014), a chef grilling eel at the front (May 2017), clear pricing for bento (February 2024), and a business run by three generations of one family (May 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Unagi bento; Yawata-maki.

anecdotes.text: A December 2017 shopper, asked to buy a rolled dish for the New Year osechi, switched to the Yawata-maki here and made it a family New Year item.
A May 2026 visitor came after watching a drama about moving to Kyoto, and was impressed that three generations of one family run the shop.
A 2016 reviewer suggested tourists eat the bento on the stone steps near Kenninji — while admitting never having done so, as family lives nearby.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 惣菜・デリ・うなぎ、東山区弓矢町31、京阪清水五条駅から徒歩約5分、市バス河原町松原から東へ徒歩約5分、月〜土 9:00〜19:00、日曜定休 (月曜祝日も休み、ほか不定休)、持ち帰りのみ、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、松原通大和大路西入。口コミ (2014年9月〜2026年5月、英語): 川魚の専門店、琵琶湖と滋賀の魚、生きた鮎の水槽、関西風に店で焼く鰻、蒲焼き1本2,300円ほど (2017年)、鰻弁当、うな丼、う巻き、Yawata-maki、肝やハツの串、若鮎の塩焼き、本もろこ、しじみ、鴨ロース、ちりめん山椒、だし巻き、鰻弁当 並2,000円ほど (2026年5月)、三代続く家族の店。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the window; takeaway only; cards, e-money and QR.

existence.note: Official Tabelog listing; latest review May 2026.

kyoto_torihachi_shijo.gf_detail: Ask. Yakitori seasoned with salt, tare or soy by cut, with fried dishes and a chicken curry to finish; no gluten information is published (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_torihachi_shijo.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday 17:00–23:00; Sunday and holidays 17:00–22:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). An early-evening course is offered roughly 17:00–19:00 (February–April 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 15 seats at a U-shaped counter; private hire up to 20; non-smoking, though grill smoke can cling to clothes (December 2025; March 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and transit IC (Tabelog). Down a narrow alley just south of Shijo-Muromachi, 214 m from Shijo Stn (Tabelog; November 2025). Opened 17 November 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_torihachi_shijo.notes: [Yakitori · Shijo-Muromachi, binchotan skewers down an alley] A fifteen-seat U-shaped counter tucked down a narrow lane south of Shijo-Muromachi, grilling brand chickens over Kishu binchotan. Go for the omakase — about 13 skewers and small dishes ending in a chicken curry — or the ¥7,000 course with all-you-can-drink. Early-evening courses are a good deal. Reviews differ on seasoning (some find it mild), and grill smoke lingers. Closed Monday.

roles: Head chef and grill cook not named
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: yakitori grilled carefully over Kishu binchotan from local and premium chickens including 阿波尾鶏, Tanba jidori and Date-dori. A November 2025 reviewer counted four staff — a young grill cook, a seasoned server and two others. Opened 17 November 2022 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Binchotan yakitori omakase.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 diner watched a young cook work the grill under the eye of the head chef.
An October 2025 visitor noted the all-you-can-drink ¥7,000 course launched for the third anniversary.
An October 2026 first-timer finished the ¥7,000 course with a chicken curry.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都 鳥八、焼き鳥・居酒屋、下京区月鉾町59-3、四条駅から214m、火〜土17:00〜23:00、日祝17:00〜22:00、月曜定休、カウンター15席、20名まで貸切可、禁煙、カード・交通系IC 可、2022年11月17日オープン。公式紹介: 紀州備長炭で丁寧に焼く焼き鳥、阿波尾鶏・丹波地鶏・伊達鶏などの地鶏や銘柄鶏、厳選の日本酒とワイン。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年10月、英語): 四条室町の南の細い路地、U字のカウンター、おまかせ13〜14品、3周年の飲み放題付き7,000円のコース、17時〜19時の早い時間のコース、締めのチキンカレー、味が薄いという声や煙が気になるという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Courses make ordering easy; counter seating only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_capri_shokudo_gojo.gf_detail: Ask. Lemon-seasoned kara-age, fried oysters, chicken cutlet, carbonara and pizza; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_capri_shokudo_gojo.vegan_detail: Ask. Meat- and seafood-led set meals; nothing vegan is marked (reviews).
kyoto_capri_shokudo_gojo.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00); dinner 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed irregularly (official site); Tabelog lists it as open year-round. Food can be slow at busy times, as it is often run by one person (October–December 2025). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 20 seats on the 1st floor (6 at the counter) plus a 2nd floor for parties of up to 15 seated or 20 standing; non-smoking; cards (JCB, VISA, Master); average spend about ¥2,000 (official site). Takeout and Uber Eats (official site). At the north-east corner of Karasuma-Manjuji, one block north of Gojo-Karasuma, 3 min from Gojo Stn (official site). Opened 17 December 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_capri_shokudo_gojo.notes: [Italian · Karasuma-Gojo, everything with lemon] A small, cheerful corner diner one block north of Gojo-Karasuma where lemons from Setoda go into every dish. Lunch is a bargain plate of salt-lemon kara-age, fried oysters or lemon carbonara with soup for about ¥1,000; evenings bring lemon steak, ajillo and a showy lemon mojito. Often run single-handed, so lunch can be slow when it fills. Upstairs room for parties. Closed irregularly.

roles: Representative of カプリ食堂 (official site’s commercial-transactions notice)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a Kyoto lemon-cuisine restaurant with two shops — this Karasuma-Gojo original and カプリ食堂 LIMONE VERDE at Imadegawa-Karasuma; the commercial-transactions notice names 金森 陽平 as representative. Tabelog says it uses domestic 瀬戸田 lemons. Reviewers in October and December 2025 describe the Gojo shop as often run by one person. Opened 17 December 2016 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Salt-lemon kara-age; lemon carbonara; lemon mojito.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 lunch guest heard from the owner about a house seasoning made with salt and lemon.
A December 2025 couple paid ¥980 each for fried-oyster and lemon kara-age set meals with soup.
A January 2026 diner added prosciutto to the signature salt-lemon kara-age set.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (capri.red): カプリ食堂、京都のレモン料理専門店、烏丸五条店 (下京区大堀町479 1階、五条駅から徒歩3分、烏丸万寿寺の北東角) と今出川御所店 カプリ食堂 LIMONE VERDE の2店、11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)、17:30〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、不定休、1階テーブル8席とカウンター6席、2階は貸切 (着席15名・立食20名)、全席禁煙、カード可 (JCB・VISA・Master)、平均予算2,000円、テイクアウト・Uber Eats、クリスマスコース5,980円・4,980円 (レモンステーキ、レモンカルボナーラ、アヒージョ、マルゲリータ、レモンアイスマチェドニア)、特定商取引法の表記: 代表者 金森陽平。食べログ: イタリアン、国産の瀬戸田レモンを使ったレモン料理専門店、名物のレモンモヒート、20席、2016年12月17日オープン。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): ランチの定食980円ほど、塩レモン唐揚げ、カキフライ、トマトレモンタルタルのチキンカツ、アボカドレモンハンバーグ、レモンカルボナーラ、ワンオペで提供が遅いことも。

cultural_comfort.note: Casual diner; bookings online.

existence.note: Official site (menu news July–August 2026) and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through March 2026.

kyoto_lamarck_imadegawa.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a French patisserie of cakes, cream puffs and tarts (2026 reviews).
kyoto_lamarck_imadegawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream, butter and eggs throughout the cakes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_lamarck_imadegawa.hours_raw: 11:00–18:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday, and some Mondays; hours may change (Tabelog). Cakes can sell out by late afternoon (June 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 6 seats at three small tables for eat-in, plus takeout; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; cards and e-money, no QR (Tabelog). About 6 min from exit 6 of Imadegawa Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 1 May 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_lamarck_imadegawa.notes: [Sweets · Imadegawa, a small French patisserie] A tiny patisserie a few minutes from Imadegawa Station, named after the Paris street where the chef once lived. The must-have is the cream puff, filled to order with Tahitian-vanilla custard under an almond crunch (about ¥390); the matcha tiramisu, pistachio dacquoise and a rare savarin also have fans. Three small tables for eating in with good coffee. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per an August 2026 review: chef Yoshida trained for five and a half years at Hotel Granvia Kyoto, worked at La Risata, spent two and a half years in France, then trained further at Ke Montebello in Osaka before opening LAMARCK in May 2019; the name comes from Rue Lamarck in Paris, where the chef lived. Tabelog gives the opening as 1 May 2019.
chef_bio.specialty: Vanilla cream puff filled to order; savarin.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 visitor at 16:00 on a Thursday was told only one kind of cake was left, and enjoyed it with Darjeeling.
An April 2026 regular loves the glass savarin, rare for a cake shop, but came back for the cream puff.
A September 2026 visitor rated the matcha tiramisu above the dacquoise, both ¥860.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: LAMARCK (ラマルク)、ケーキ・カフェ、上京区弁財天町333-1、今出川駅から322m、月・木〜日11:00〜18:00、火水定休 (月曜不定休)、イートイン6席 (2人席×3)、禁煙、子供可、カード・電子マネー可、2019年5月1日オープン。口コミ (2026年3〜10月、英語): シェフ Yoshida はホテルグランヴィア京都で5年半、La Risata、フランスで2年半、大阪の Ke Montebello を経て2019年5月に開業、店名はパリで住んでいた Rue Lamarck から。注文後に詰めるタヒチ産バニラのシュークリーム390〜398円、桃のショートケーキ880円、抹茶ティラミス860円、ピスタチオのダックワーズ860円、ショコラフランボワーズ702円、炒り京番茶と和栗のタルト715円、グラスのサバラン。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the showcase; only six seats for eating in.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_nikuya_kagura.gf_detail: Ask. Wagyu with several sauces, simmered dishes, curry and cold noodles to finish; no gluten information is published (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nikuya_kagura.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku and meat-kaiseki house (Tabelog).
kyoto_nikuya_kagura.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00), Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday, irregularly, and over Obon and New Year (Tabelog). À la carte orders carry a ¥3,300 starter (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「前菜3300円(単品注文のみ)」); courses avoid it. 28 seats: an 8-seat counter downstairs for meat kaiseki, and upstairs a 2-seat bar counter, semi-private rooms for 4 and 6 and a private room for 8, used for yakiniku and suki-shabu; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR including PayPay (Tabelog; July 2025). In a renovated machiya with a small front garden and white noren at Muromachi south of Oshikoji, 188 m from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Opened 5 April 2012 as 肉家 桜真 in Kamitoba and moved here (Tabelog).
kyoto_nikuya_kagura.notes: [Yakiniku · Muromachi-Oike, a wholesaler's wagyu in a machiya] A meat wholesaler's own restaurant in a renovated townhouse off Muromachi, with a garden path and white noren. Downstairs is a counter for meat kaiseki; upstairs, private rooms for yakiniku and suki-shabu. The ¥10,000 Kagura course runs to 13 plates — wagyu nigiri, roast beef, tongue sashimi, grilled cuts and cold noodles — and is generous. À la carte adds a ¥3,300 starter. Closed Sunday.

roles: Run directly by the meat wholesaler Gyusho Kagura (Tabelog); no chef named
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: run directly by the meat wholesaler Gyusho Kagura, serving A5 and A4 wagyu from à la carte to courses, with a regularly changing wine list; moved from Kamitoba to Muromachi-Oike. Tabelog gives the opening as 5 April 2012, under the former name 肉家 桜真.
chef_bio.specialty: Kagura course of wagyu yakiniku and meat kaiseki.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 diner singled out the wagyu nigiri, tongue stew and daikon in oxtail broth on the appetizer platter.
A March 2026 regular comes back once a year and ends with the cold noodles.
A January 2026 guest found the course portions generous to the point of being overwhelming.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 肉家かぐら (旧店名 肉家 桜真)、焼肉・しゃぶしゃぶ、中京区室町通押小路下る御池之町309、烏丸御池駅から188m、月〜土17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、日曜定休・不定休・お盆と年末年始休み、前菜3,300円 (単品注文のみ)、28席 (1階カウンター8、2階カウンター2・半個室4名と6名・完全個室8名)、20名まで貸切可、禁煙、カード・QR 可、2012年4月5日オープン。公式紹介: 上鳥羽から室町御池に移転、精肉卸 Gyusho Kagura の直営、A5・A4の和牛をアラカルトからコースまで、ワインは定期的に入れ替え。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): かぐらコース13品10,000円、和牛握り、牛タンシチュー、テールスープの大根、ローストビーフ、タンとハラミの刺身、締めのカレーや冷麺、町家を改装、前庭と白い暖簾。

cultural_comfort.note: Courses avoid the ¥3,300 à la carte starter charge.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through March 2026.

kyoto_comorebi_ramen_house.gf_detail: Ask: two diners name a gluten-free brown-rice salt ramen, "Shio Genmai Soba" (January and October 2026). The regular noodles and shoyu tare contain wheat, and it is one small open kitchen, so confirm when ordering.
kyoto_comorebi_ramen_house.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken and seafood broths, pork and chicken chashu, quail eggs; a venison ramen in summer (2026 reviews).
kyoto_comorebi_ramen_house.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sat 11:00–14:00; closed Sunday and Monday; hours may change. An April 2026 diner noted reduced opening days for a while. No reservations; queues before opening, with waiting seats inside (2026 reviews). About 8 counter seats facing an open kitchen; bowls are made one at a time, so service is unhurried (2026 reviews). Non-smoking. No cards; e-money and QR (Tabelog). Opened 3 February 2021 (Tabelog).
kyoto_comorebi_ramen_house.notes: [Ramen · west of Shijo-Karasuma, clear gentle broths] A bright, café-like eight-seat counter near Shijo Station where the owner, trained at the Shiga ramen shop Nikkou, makes each bowl to order: clear chicken shoyu or shio with seasonal vegetables and a gluten-free brown-rice version, plus limited bowls like venison shoyu. Lunch only, Tue–Sat. Some find it pricey or slow, and one found the shio too salty and oily (March 2026).

roles: Owner-chef, not named; trained at a well-known ramen shop in Shiga, "Nikkou" (2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Opened 3 February 2021 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 say the owner previously worked at the famous Shiga ramen shop Nikkou and has won awards; describe a clean, café-like counter with an open kitchen, kind staff, waiting seats placed so waiting guests do not face diners, and a ramen meant to be eaten every day, simple and free from chemical seasoning.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per an August 2026 diner: ramen you could eat every day, gentle on the body.
chef_bio.specialty: Clear shoyu and shio ramen with seasonal vegetables.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular’s limited venison shoyu came with three chashu: "the first slice was delicious—was it beef? The second slice was also delicious—not beef! And the third slice was venison!"
"The broth was quite salty, topped with fragrant chicken oil, but honestly, the strong flavors of the oil and salt made it difficult to appreciate the overall taste." — March 2026.
October 2026: ramen plus a chicken chashu bowl came to over ¥1,500, "a bit pricey for lunch," and the bowl took a while — better "for those who want to take their time."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: comorebi Ramen house、ラーメン、下京区綾小路通新町西入矢田町126 Bell Forme 平安 1F、四条駅から307m、火〜土 11:00〜14:00、日月休み、予約不可、禁煙、カード不可、電子マネー・QR可、2021年2月3日オープン。口コミ (2026年1月〜10月、英語): 店主は滋賀の有名店 Nikkou の出身、受賞歴、カフェのような店内、オープンキッチンのカウンター約8席、待ち席あり、一杯ずつ丁寧に作る、化学調味料なしの澄んだ鶏のスープ、醤油ラーメン1,000円、塩ラーメンに山椒、グルテンフリーの玄米塩ラーメン (Shio Genmai Soba)、玄米塩の大盛り野菜増し1,700円、豚と鶏のチャーシュー、うずらの味玉、太めのメンマ、季節の焼き野菜、限定の味噌カレー・酒粕味噌・海老トマト味噌・冷やし・鹿の醤油ラーメン1,600円、鶏チャーシュー丼、きのこと煮干しの醤油まぜそば、塩が強く油が多いという声、昼に1,500円超えは割高という声、営業日が減っていた時期。

cultural_comfort.note: Order before you sit; many foreign visitors (April 2026).

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_deux_cochons.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: onion tart, pâté with country bread, and bread served alongside the cheese and ham (2022–2025 reviews).
kyoto_deux_cochons.vegan_detail: Not vegan: charcuterie, pâtés, gizzard confit and cheese (reviews).
kyoto_deux_cochons.hours_raw: Tabelog: 18:00–22:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change. 12 seats, tables only, for groups of two or more (Tabelog); a November 2023 diner says the name, "two pigs", reflects that it takes parties from two. Non-smoking. Cards (Visa, Master, JCB, Amex, Diners); no PayPay — card or cash (Tabelog; October 2025). Tabelog lists no service charge.
kyoto_deux_cochons.notes: [Natural-wine bistro · near Shijo-Karasuma, Loire bottles] A twelve-seat bistro bar in a machiya near Shijo-Karasuma, with records playing and a shelf of natural wines to pick from — many from the Loire — beside pâté de campagne, an onion tart and cured ham. Tables only, for two or more. Glasses from ¥950. Cards or cash, no PayPay. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner, not named; has a Loire connection per a September 2022 diner
chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2019 to 2025 describe a natural-wine bistro in a renovated machiya near Shijo-Karasuma that feels like a Paris bistro, with French cheeses, bottles on the shelf to choose from, a strong showing of Loire wines (the owner seemed to have a Loire connection, September 2022), records in the background, and a small but wine-friendly menu with seasonal Kyoto vegetables.
chef_bio.specialty: Natural wine by the bottle; pâté de campagne; onion tart.

anecdotes.text: "It felt just like a bistro in Paris!" — August 2022.
"The owner seems to have a connection to the Loire Valley in France, and I was truly delighted by the abundance of Loire wines available." — September 2022.
"While the selection of dishes may not be extensive, it was more than enough for enjoying wine." — July 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ドゥ コション (Deux Cochons)、バル・ワインバー、中京区新町通蛸薬師下ル百足屋町372-3、烏丸駅から北西へ徒歩5分、18:00〜22:00、火曜休み、12席 (テーブルのみ、2名から)、禁煙、カード可、電子マネー不可。口コミ (2019〜2025年、英語): 町家を改装した自然派ワインのビストロ、棚から選ぶボトル、ロワールのワインが多い、店名は「2匹の豚」で2名から、グラス950円から、生ハム2種1,600円、鶏レバーパテとパン・ド・カンパーニュ850円、砂肝のコンフィ800円、焼きとうもろこしのオムレツ1,200円、玉ねぎのタルト、パテ・ド・カンパーニュ、レンズ豆とかぼちゃのサラダ、鰹のカルパッチョ、フランスのチーズ、京野菜、レコード、PayPay不可、パリのビストロのよう、料理の品数は多くない。

cultural_comfort.note: Pick a bottle from the shelf; tables for two or more.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through October 2025.

kyoto_nama_chocolat_tea_house.gf_detail: Ask: the nama chocolate itself is not described as containing wheat, but the cakes (chocolate cake, apple-raisin cake, marble cheesecake) are not confirmed either way (2026 reviews). Ask the owners.
kyoto_nama_chocolat_tea_house.vegan_detail: Not vegan: nama chocolate is made with cream; cakes come with cream (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nama_chocolat_tea_house.hours_raw: Tabelog: 12:00–19:00 (last order); closed irregularly; Tabelog remarks also say closed Tuesday but open on holidays, while the official site says closed on public holidays. Reservations through the official site, up to three groups at a time (Tabelog). 16 seats in two tatami rooms and on the engawa, with a garden view; no air-conditioning in summer 2026, a breeze and mosquito coils instead (reviews). Non-smoking; children welcome; cards (Visa, Master, Amex), e-money and QR (official site; Tabelog). Take-home nama chocolate packed with ice packs. Opened 17 September 2005 (Tabelog).
kyoto_nama_chocolat_tea_house.notes: [Nama-chocolate tea house · Okazaki, an old house and garden] Down a narrow lane near Heian Shrine, a tea house in an old farmhouse-style home with two tatami rooms and an engawa over the garden, run by a couple — she explains in English, he in Japanese (June 2026). A ¥1,320 set of four nama chocolates with a drink, cakes plated with flowers, and boxes to take home. No air-conditioning in summer. Up to three groups booked at once.

roles: Run by a couple, not named (June 2026)
chef_bio.background: Opened 17 September 2005 (Tabelog), in a renovated old Kyoto house near Heian Shrine (official site). A June 2026 diner describes a couple: the wife, from overseas, serves mainly in English with detailed explanations, while the Japanese husband helps take-out customers in Japanese; they brought a cushion and moved the fan for comfort and dimmed the lights for the chocolate. An October 2026 diner found the owner running it alone that day. Earlier visitors (2016) met a dog and a cat.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: organic, body-friendly drinks and cakes; nama chocolate that melts in the mouth.
chef_bio.specialty: Nama chocolate set.

anecdotes.text: June 2026: "The wife is from overseas, while the husband is Japanese. The wife primarily handles the service in English… When takeout customers arrive, the husband assists them in Japanese."
A July 2026 diner ordered chocolate cake and got "a dessert plate that looked like a jungle on the plate" — watermelon and, it seemed, a mugwort sauce.
"Even in the middle of summer, there’s no air conditioning! The scent of mosquito coils fills the air." — September 2026.
October 2026: the worn menu made some prices hard to read, and "since no one came to check on me, I was able to relax and take my time."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都生ショコラ オーガニックティーハウス、平安神宮の近くの古民家を改装したティーハウス、オーガニックの飲み物やケーキ、生チョコレートは保冷袋でお土産に、オーガニックコーヒー、無農薬果汁のドリンク、ビター・スウィート・抹茶の生チョコ、2005年創業、月〜日 12:00〜19:00、祝日休み、駐車場なし、カード (VISA・Master・AMEX)・電子マネー・QR可、全席禁煙、左京区岡崎天王町76-15。食べログ: カフェ・チョコレート、予約は公式サイトから (3組まで)、16席、座敷、テラス、子供可、不定休 (火曜休みで祝日は営業とも)、2005年9月17日オープン。口コミ (2016年、2026年4月〜10月、英語): 海外出身の奥さんが英語で、日本人のご主人が日本語で接客、チョコレートセットとドリンク1,320円 (スウィート・ビター・抹茶・クランベリー)、チョコレートケーキ、りんごとレーズンのケーキ、マーブルチーズケーキ、コールドチョコレート、和紅茶、たんぽぽコーヒー、最初にブレンドの日本茶、生花の飾り、エアコンなしで蚊取り線香と扇風機、縁側の席、細い路地の奥、入口がわかりにくい、メニューが古く値段が読みにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: Service in English and Japanese (June 2026).

existence.note: Official site live; Tabelog reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_factory_kafe_kosen.gf_detail: Ask: coffee itself is fine, but the food is toast, cakes and bread (2026 reviews).
kyoto_factory_kafe_kosen.vegan_detail: Ask: black coffee is plant-based; floats, cheesecake and banana toast are not (2026 reviews).
kyoto_factory_kafe_kosen.hours_raw: Tabelog: 12:00–21:00; closed Tuesday, open when a holiday falls on Tuesday; hours may change; temporary closures posted on the roaster’s site (official site). No reservations; second floor, often full on weekend afternoons (2026 reviews). 7 counter seats per Tabelog; a September 2026 diner also saw tables. Smoking allowed inside (Tabelog; June and September 2026). No cards per Tabelog; e-money and QR; a September 2026 diner listed card, e-money, PayPay and cash. Take-out.
kyoto_factory_kafe_kosen.notes: [Coffee house · Kawaramachi-Imadegawa, the Ooya roaster’s flannel-drip café] A second-floor café in a retro building near Demachiyanagi, run by the Kyoto roaster Ooya Coffee: no blends — pick the origin and say "rich" or "light", and it comes flannel-dripped in a little pot. Coffee floats with clove-and-orange ice cream, banana toast. Smoking is allowed inside. Busy with tourists on weekends. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Run by オオヤコーヒ焙煎所 (official site); a September 2026 diner names the roaster as "Minoru Ooya"
chef_bio.background: Per the official site of オオヤコーヒ焙煎所 (ooyacoffee associees, since 2007): the roaster’s directly run shops are this flannel-drip coffee house in Kyoto, a ten-days-a-month stand in Shirahama, Wakayama, and Café gewa in Kurashiki, Okayama; it also sells by contract and wholesale. Reviewers in 2026 describe a clean, calm second-floor room with a green view, friendly staff, a counter facing an open kitchen, and a crowd of couples, women and tourists.
chef_bio.specialty: Flannel-drip single origins; coffee float.

anecdotes.text: "It was also wonderful to find a stylish café that allows smoking, which is quite rare." — June 2026.
A September 2026 diner asked about the light roast’s strong aroma and learned "it can sometimes occur with freshly roasted beans."
August 2026: the clove-and-orange ice cream had run out; the Earl Grey one "didn’t have much of an Earl Grey flavor."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ooyacoffeeassociees.com): オオヤコーヒ焙煎所、直営店は自家焙煎ネルドリップコーヒー専門店の京都 KAFE工船、毎月10日間限定営業の和歌山・白浜STAND!、岡山・倉敷のカフェゲバ、家庭用の契約販売と業務用卸、2007年〜。食べログ: FACTORY KAFE 工船、カフェ、上京区河原町通今出川下ル梶井町448 清和テナントハウス2F G号室、河原町今出川バス停から徒歩2分、出町柳駅から徒歩5分、12:00〜21:00、火曜休み (祝日は営業)、予約不可、カウンター7席、喫煙可、カード不可、電子マネー・QR可、テイクアウト。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月、英語): ネルドリップ、ブレンドはなく産地と焙煎度と「濃い」「軽い」を選ぶ、タイ・インドネシア・ブラジル・ペルー、ポットで出る、コーヒーフロート1,200円 (クローブとオレンジピールのアイス)、アールグレイのアイス、桃のソーダ、バナナトースト、マスカットのレアチーズケーキ、2階、週末は満席、観光客が多い、店内で喫煙できる、焙煎家 Minoru Ooya。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff ask about taste and suggest beans; smoking allowed inside.

existence.note: Roaster’s site lists it with November 2026 notices; Tabelog reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_factory_kafe_kosen.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260302/26006310/ (35.027359, 135.769577); GSI 京都府京都市上京区梶井町448番地 (lot) is 157m south, over the 150m limit, so the pin is kept at Tabelog and marked approximate; 2026-11-06

kyoto_creperie_garcon.gf_detail: Ask. Savoury galettes and sweet crepes; the batters are not described, and crepe batter is usually wheat (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_creperie_garcon.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter, caramel, cheese, ham and egg (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_creperie_garcon.hours_raw: Tue, Wed, Fri–Sun 11:30–18:00; closed Mon and Thu; hours may change (Tabelog) — a July 2026 regular found it open by 10:30, opening as soon as everything was ready. No bookings; one order per person; no photos of the interior (menu and food photos are fine) (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). 10 table seats in a long, narrow room; one crepe is cooked at a time, so it takes a while (Tabelog; July 2026 review). Near Yasui Konpira Shrine; 675 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_creperie_garcon.notes: [Crêperie · by Yasui Konpira Shrine] A narrow, European-style crêperie where galettes and crepes come crisp and fragrant, one at a time: prosciutto-camembert-fig galette, then a crepe with house caramel or seasonal fruit. About ¥1,500–2,500. Cash only; no bookings; one order each. Closed Mon and Thu.

chef_bio.background: Opened 10 April 2015 (Tabelog). A June 2026 diner felt it was run like a family business.
chef_bio.specialty: Crisp galettes; caramel crepes.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 galette eater wished the savoury galettes were warmer and the egg cooked longer, and preferred the banana-caramel dessert.
In June 2026 the long room was full of Western tourists and some arrivals were turned away.
An October 2025 regular about to move away came once more for the fig caramel crepe, minus the banana.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ギャルソン クレープ (Creperie GARCON)、クレープ・ガレット・カフェ、東山区下弁天町53-3、祇園四条駅から675m、火水金土日 11:30〜18:00、月木休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、テーブル10席、禁煙、2015年4月10日オープン、注文はお一人様一品、店内の撮影不可 (メニューと料理は可)。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年7月、英語): Yasui Konpira Shrine の近く、パリッと香ばしい生地、生ハム・カマンベール・いちじくのガレット、自家製キャラメルソースのクレープ、チョコとオレンジ、いちじくとバナナ、1月のりんごのコンポート、生メロンのキャラメル1,780円、生レモンのシュガーバター、クレープは千円超から、一枚ずつ焼くので時間がかかる、欧米の観光客で満席の日も。

cultural_comfort.note: Menu displayed outside; no interior photos; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.
